0182d1f23cb7.en: At dawn, the maids leave for home
0182d1f23cb7.t: Waktu subuh, para pembantu rumah balik ke rumah

026b420d703e.en: Itanema asks, seemingly out of nowhere, but with a decent amount of backstory behind it: "Sora, don't you want to go home to your parents?" Sora shies away and hugs her pillow. "Running from it all again… It's not working, is it?" Aurora sits by Sora and rests Sora's head on her breasts. "C'mon, Itanema, leave her alone. Sora, no rush." "No rush? Are we planning to live like we're in cooking and accounting school for the rest of our lives?" "It's not so bad. I do feel pretty safe." Itanema disagrees, but says nothing. A knock on the door.
026b420d703e.t: Itanema bertanya, seolah-olah entah dari mana, tetapi dengan latar cerita yang agak banyak di sebaliknya: “Sora, kau tak nak balik kepada mak ayah kau ke?” Sora mengelak dan memeluk bantalnya. “Lari daripada semuanya lagi… Tak berkesan, kan?” Aurora duduk di sebelah Sora dan menyandarkan kepala Sora di dadanya. “Sudahlah, Itanema, jangan kacau dia. Sora, tak perlu tergesa-gesa.” “Tak perlu tergesa-gesa? Kita nak hidup macam kita di sekolah masakan dan perakaunan seumur hidup ke?” “Tak teruk sangat. Aku rasa agak selamat.” Itanema tidak setuju, tetapi tidak berkata apa-apa. Ketukan di pintu.

0376d412f4aa.en: Kibe and his guard captains go through their daily work
0376d412f4aa.t: Kibe dan kapten pengawalnya menjalankan kerja harian mereka

037814020734.en: "Just—just one more thing. I'm nominating Kibe as my apprentice." Kibe, walking off in the distance, thinks his ears just stopped working. "Kibe is exceptional at following specific directions, so he'd be my perfect right hand. On which note, I'll also officially introduce a vote to rename the position." The crowd stares at Kibe. "What?" Huneo smiles: "Pay will be the same as an apprentice's." Kibe shudders.
037814020734.t: “Cuma—cuma satu perkara lagi. Saya mencalonkan Kibe sebagai perantis saya.” Kibe, yang sedang berjalan pergi di kejauhan, menyangka telinganya baru berhenti berfungsi. “Kibe sangat cemerlang mengikut arahan khusus, jadi dia akan jadi tangan kanan saya yang sempurna. Berkenaan itu, saya juga akan secara rasmi memperkenalkan undian untuk menamakan semula jawatan itu.” Orang ramai merenung Kibe. “Apa?” Huneo tersenyum: “Gajinya sama seperti gaji perantis.” Kibe menggigil.

04ff14d0e6e4.en: Eiri holds back a smile. "If you're so sorry, then you'll come live with me." The maids laugh. Sora, relieved but apprehensive: "Yes, Big Momma." "Good. You're all free to go home in the morning. But! The guards will still go with you for a while, until I figure out this fishy smell." Sora: "Itanema already did." "Really? I'm all ears, then."
04ff14d0e6e4.t: Eiri menahan senyum. “Kalau kau betul-betul menyesal, kau akan datang tinggal dengan aku.” Para pembantu rumah ketawa. Sora, lega tetapi cemas: “Ya, Mak Besar.” “Bagus. Korang semua bebas balik rumah pagi esok. Tapi! Pengawal tetap akan ikut korang buat sementara, sampai aku faham bau ikan ni.” Sora: “Itanema dah faham.” “Betul? Aku pasang telinga, kalau macam tu.”

04ffd1cf0e22.en: (Art note: maybe add a Wozen nari gel mix to her: make it cute, but show the Magina man is into weird kinks.)
04ffd1cf0e22.t: (Nota seni: mungkin tambah campuran nari gel Wozen padanya: buat dia comel, tapi tunjukkan lelaki Magina itu suka fetish pelik.)

0652ae8104e9.en: Morika has finished burying Gabiro's research. Posaqui: "Yessu! I laid a total of thirty-five misdirections for the adventurers." Namia: three adventurers stumbled onto where Sinoi was held captive, but found nothing new.
0652ae8104e9.t: Morika sudah selesai menanam penyelidikan Gabiro. Posaqui: “Yessu! Aku dah pasang sejumlah tiga puluh lima jejak palsu untuk pengembara.” Namia: tiga orang pengembara terjumpa tempat Sinoi ditawan, tetapi tidak menjumpai apa-apa yang baharu.

0710bd0d13e7.en: Ryo stops the wagon and tries to talk to her, but she only calls for her sister before collapsing on him. "Get me some nari gel. ASAP!"
0710bd0d13e7.t: Ryo memberhentikan gerabak dan cuba bercakap dengannya, tetapi dia hanya memanggil adiknya sebelum rebah ke atasnya. “Ambilkan aku nari gel. SEGERA!”

072133fcbf76.en: Trembling with rage, Eori lifts Huneo off the ground, moments from giving him free dental work— "You're no better than them, Princess Eori." Neferteri's cold voice reaches her, and a flood of memories hits: her hot blood is no different from her sisters'. Itagiba: "Them? Ohhhh. That's low," but it goes unheard. Eori shoves Huneo away and storms out.
072133fcbf76.t: Menggigil kerana marah, Eori mengangkat Huneo dari tanah, beberapa saat lagi akan memberinya rawatan gigi percuma— “Anakanda tidak lebih baik daripada mereka, Puteri Eori.” Suara dingin Neferteri sampai kepadanya, dan banjir ingatan melanda: darah panasnya tiada beza dengan darah kakak-kakaknya. Itagiba: “Mereka? Ohhhh. Kejamnya tu,” tetapi tidak didengari. Eori menolak Huneo dan keluar dengan marah.

0748b6c46635.en: His body convulses. His mouth clamps shut on his own tongue, bloody foam forming around it, suffocating him. The gurgling stops as his lungs fill up. He calms down, and falls into a sound sleep, somewhere in the forest. (Clodoveu and Wilson are gone for good.)
0748b6c46635.t: Badannya kejang. Mulutnya terkatup pada lidahnya sendiri, buih berdarah terbentuk di sekelilingnya, melemaskannya. Bunyi berdeguk berhenti ketika paru-parunya penuh. Dia tenang, dan jatuh lena, di suatu tempat dalam hutan. (Clodoveu dan Wilson sudah tiada buat selamanya.)

07caa2ee21a8.en: Clodoveu: "Uffda. That was pretty good. Ohh? That took some of your energy, huh? Wilson! Cold Water! Wilson!" He looks back and sees Wilson fleeing for his life. "Haaaa, you dickass. I'm gonna remember that!" He readies his hand and cracks his neck. "Well, I'm dead either way."
07caa2ee21a8.t: Clodoveu: “Uffda. Boleh tahan tu. Ohh? Itu makan sikit tenaga kau, kan? Wilson! Air Sejuk! Wilson!” Dia menoleh dan nampak Wilson lari menyelamatkan nyawa. “Haaaa, kau bangsat. Aku akan ingat ni!” Dia menyiapkan tangannya dan meletupkan lehernya. “Yalah, aku mati juga apa pun.”

08b6c4d64fd9.en: Silent tears pour down Katsuki's face as her hands calm down. "One. Trust broken. Two. No sister."
08b6c4d64fd9.t: Air mata senyap mengalir di wajah Katsuki ketika tangannya tenang. “Satu. Kepercayaan hancur. Dua. Bukan kakak.”

08c20d5cb177.en: Everything is freshly demolished: blood and chunks of bodies everywhere. Katsumi looks distraught, the adventurer confused, and Ryo curious. Ryo: "Maybe one of them is {WIP-maginafarmBoss}?" Adventurer: "I'm not healing bandits! That's where I draw the line." "I never said that! So, where do you think she is?" Katsumi: "In the bedroom!"
08c20d5cb177.t: Segalanya baru dimusnahkan: darah dan ketulan badan di merata-rata. Katsumi nampak kecewa, pengembara keliru, dan Ryo ingin tahu. Ryo: “Mungkin salah seorang daripada mereka {WIP-maginafarmBoss}?” Pengembara: “Aku tak sembuhkan penyamun! Di situlah had aku.” “Aku tak pernah cakap macam tu! Jadi, kau rasa dia di mana?” Katsumi: “Di bilik tidur!”

0a59d5cae6b5.en: Morika comes in to feed her; she gets aggressive, and it turns violent. He knocks her out. Nobody can really deal with her, so they pour Black Honey down her throat.
0a59d5cae6b5.t: Morika masuk untuk memberinya makan; dia menjadi agresif, dan keadaan bertukar ganas. Lelaki itu memengsankannya. Tiada siapa betul-betul boleh menanganinya, jadi mereka menuang Black Honey ke dalam kerongkongnya.

0aac3b337d8f.en: "Go suck a big fat—" Marcus, meanwhile, takes a nari gel from his pocket, dips another knife in it and throws it at Harry as he gets ready to charge again. Marcus steps back for distance and readies another knife, then sees a fireball forming between Harry's tusks, speeding toward him. He launches the knife; they meet midway and explode in a curtain of fire. Marcus flips Harry off. "Fuck—" Something large flies through the curtain of flame.
0aac3b337d8f.t: “Pergi hisap batang besar—” Marcus, sementara itu, mengambil satu nari gel dari poketnya, mencelup sebilah lagi pisau ke dalamnya dan membalingnya kepada Harry ketika dia bersedia menerpa lagi. Marcus berundur untuk menjarakkan diri dan menyiapkan sebilah lagi pisau, kemudian nampak bebola api terbentuk di antara taring Harry, meluru ke arahnya. Dia melepaskan pisau itu; kedua-duanya bertemu di tengah dan meletup dalam tirai api. Marcus menunjuk jari tengah kepada Harry. “Celak—” Sesuatu yang besar terbang menembusi tirai api.

0b15ffe8389c.en: Huneo sets a Nari Refresher on the table near her. "You're doing this to yourself. Respect me, and I'll respect you." Silent, eyes bloodshot, her arm pumping blood with every heartbeat. He leaves. "You'd better heal yourself and clean up before you pass out and die. Guards, don't let her leave. I'll have Eiri bring her dinner here."
0b15ffe8389c.t: Huneo meletakkan Nari Refresher di atas meja dekatnya. “Kau buat ini kepada diri sendiri. Hormati saya, dan saya akan hormati kau.” Senyap, mata merah menyala, lengannya memancutkan darah dengan setiap degupan jantung. Dia beredar. “Baik kau sembuhkan diri dan bersihkan sebelum kau pengsan dan mati. Pengawal, jangan biar dia keluar. Saya akan suruh Eiri bawa makan malamnya ke sini.”

0c1217744332.en: A sinking feeling sets in, getting worse with every step: thick saliva, a clenched throat, a turning stomach. He holds onto a tree and pukes his guts out, weaker than before, then wanders on, aimless, under graying skies.
0c1217744332.t: Rasa tenggelam mula datang, semakin teruk dengan setiap langkah: air liur pekat, tekak tercekik, perut memulas. Dia berpaut pada sebatang pokok dan muntah sepuas-puasnya, lebih lemah daripada sebelumnya, kemudian merayau lagi, tanpa tujuan, di bawah langit yang semakin kelabu.

0ce262b8144c.en: Huneo comes in with a Sanbi guard and looks around. "You'll have to pay for all this damage too, Princess Eori." Rage rises; she starts toward him, then stops: the guards have arrows aimed at her head. "I've received permission to do as I please to guarantee my safety." Huneo smiles, almost enjoying putting her in her place.
0ce262b8144c.t: Huneo masuk bersama seorang pengawal Sanbi dan melihat sekeliling. “Kau perlu bayar semua kerosakan ini juga, Puteri Eori.” Kemarahan memuncak; dia mula melangkah ke arahnya, kemudian berhenti: pengawal menghala anak panah ke kepalanya. “Saya sudah menerima kebenaran untuk berbuat sesuka hati bagi menjamin keselamatan saya.” Huneo tersenyum, hampir menikmati meletakkannya di tempatnya.

0dde1c23faf8.en: Eiri: "Next matter: Fanchaki. Gabiro's Fanchaki research isn't panning out the way he envisioned. The new Fanchakis are juicier and thicker, but they're more willing to fight back now, and they seem to have more Soul Energy too." "Are we still profiting?" "Yes, but I forecast breaking even, or a loss, if the amount of nari gel stone keeps going up." "Why?" "Healing. The Fanchakis have gotten more aggressive, as if they realized they're being culled." Itagiba: "Well, I can still spin that as a positive. I vote we just release them into the wild when we stop making money." Huneo has grievances, but it's three against one. Eiri: "Next topic: Harry."
0dde1c23faf8.t: Eiri: “Perkara seterusnya: Fanchaki. Penyelidikan Fanchaki Gabiro tidak menjadi seperti yang dia bayangkan. Fanchaki baharu lebih berair dan tebal, tetapi mereka lebih sanggup melawan sekarang, dan nampaknya ada lebih banyak Tenaga Jiwa juga.” “Kita masih untung?” “Ya, tapi aku jangka pulang modal, atau rugi, kalau jumlah batu nari gel terus naik.” “Kenapa?” “Penyembuhan. Fanchaki makin agresif, macam mereka sedar mereka sedang dimusnahkan.” Itagiba: “Yalah, aku masih boleh pusingkan itu jadi positif. Aku undi kita lepaskan saja mereka ke alam liar bila kita berhenti buat duit.” Huneo ada rungutan, tetapi tiga lawan satu. Eiri: “Topik seterusnya: Harry.”

0fb866625abc.en: Neferteri dodges the questions to get Huneo off her trail, and Itagiba covers for her with the same story he gave everyone else. Eiri wants to come clean, but cowers under Neferteri's gaze.
0fb866625abc.t: Neferteri mengelak soalan untuk mengalihkan Huneo daripada jejaknya, dan Itagiba melindunginya dengan cerita yang sama yang dia beri kepada semua orang. Eiri mahu berterus terang, tetapi kecut di bawah renungan Neferteri.

0fe30f71299f.en: {WIP-maginafarmBoss}, the farm's boss, gets up after being slammed into the wall; Harry, seen from behind, is nearly spent
0fe30f71299f.t: {WIP-maginafarmBoss}, bos ladang itu, bangun selepas dihempas ke dinding; Harry, dilihat dari belakang, hampir kehabisan tenaga

108ec496671e.en: Forest all around. What should I do? Where do I go? He sees the sisters again in his mind, and remembers the moment Katsumi kicked him out.
108ec496671e.t: Hutan di sekeliling. Apa patut aku buat? Ke mana aku nak pergi? Dia nampak adik-beradik itu lagi dalam fikirannya, dan teringat saat Katsumi menghalaunya.

10ac32f1686f.en: "Say, do you guys have a many-husbands policy or what?" Severino: "What does that have to do with anything?" "Just curious. There are like 10 guys for every woman here." "I see what you're saying. Most of the women and children are hidden in the barracks behind us." "Got it. You guys—"
10ac32f1686f.t: “Eh, korang ada polisi ramai suami ke apa?” Severino: “Apa kaitannya?” “Saja nak tahu. Ada macam 10 lelaki untuk setiap perempuan di sini.” “Aku faham maksud kau. Kebanyakan perempuan dan kanak-kanak bersembunyi di berek di belakang kami.” “Faham. Korang—”

10b0d9a34240.en: Eiri: "On the budget side, how much are you asking for?" "20 Sapphires up front, plus 5 Sapphires a week." "A week? Our weekly gains are around 2 right now! I can do 5 weeks of that, at most, without straining our coffers." Neferteri: "As Eiri so eloquently put it. You could assign your own guards to hunt down Gabiro's research." "Those guards are already protecting the city. I need more resources."
10b0d9a34240.t: Eiri: “Dari segi bajet, berapa yang kau minta?” “20 Sapphire di depan, ditambah 5 Sapphire seminggu.” “Seminggu? Keuntungan mingguan kita sekitar 2 sekarang! Aku boleh tanggung 5 minggu, paling lama, tanpa menekan perbendaharaan kita.” Neferteri: “Seperti yang Eiri katakan dengan begitu fasih. Kau boleh tugaskan pengawalmu sendiri untuk memburu penyelidikan Gabiro.” “Pengawal itu sudah melindungi bandar. Saya perlukan lebih banyak sumber.”

135b86eb5118.en: Clodoveu and Wilson, holding his nose, stand ready with buckets. Dried blood and dirt cloud the water dripping off Harry. Clodoveu: "Hey there! Sorry about the water, but we don't want you setting the basement on fire." Wilson: "Phew. Did you ever take a bath? My man, you stink like ass! Like an ass left to rot in the sun."
135b86eb5118.t: Clodoveu dan Wilson, memicit hidung, berdiri sedia dengan baldi. Darah kering dan kotoran mengeruhkan air yang menitis dari Harry. Clodoveu: “Hai! Maaf pasal air tu, tapi kami tak nak kau bakar ruang bawah tanah ni.” Wilson: “Fuh. Kau pernah mandi ke? Kawan, kau busuk macam bontot! Macam bontot yang dibiar reput bawah matahari.”

13758efa5b4a.en: One Bagarisa stands up, its back lit on fire. The others notice too, and get defensive.
13758efa5b4a.t: Seekor Bagarisa berdiri, belakangnya terbakar. Yang lain perasan juga, dan bersiap mempertahankan diri.

138b10a96ce3.en: Clodoveu rushes Harry, who crosses his arms in an X to defend. Clodoveu looks at the X, then at his lower body, stops midway and lets his two-handed mace fly at Harry's gut. Harry's big arm drops and takes the brunt: flesh, bone and soul fire fly everywhere.
138b10a96ce3.t: Clodoveu menerpa Harry, yang menyilangkan lengan dalam bentuk X untuk bertahan. Clodoveu memandang X itu, kemudian bahagian bawah badannya, berhenti separuh jalan dan melepaskan cokmar dua tangannya ke perut Harry. Lengan besar Harry jatuh dan menerima hentakan utama: daging, tulang dan api jiwa berterbangan ke mana-mana.

13a377623aa5.en: The map: the target is Maicon's warehouse

156beb60fa5b.en: Clodoveu: "So yeah. You're in no position to make requests, but if you spill everything you know, I'll let you join the team." Wilson: "You sure?" Clodoveu nods. "So, Harry?" Harry pictures the Bagarisas' happy little smiles. "You fucking killed them! I'm not joining you!" "That's too bad. Then I've got no choice but to make you meet the darkness." Clodoveu readies his weapon while Wilson grabs a bucket.
156beb60fa5b.t: Clodoveu: “Jadi ya. Kau tak ada hak nak minta apa-apa, tapi kalau kau bocorkan semua yang kau tahu, aku bagi kau masuk pasukan.” Wilson: “Kau pasti?” Clodoveu mengangguk. “Jadi, Harry?” Harry membayangkan senyuman kecil gembira Bagarisa. “Korang bunuh mereka, celaka! Aku takkan sertai korang!” “Sayang sekali. Kalau macam tu aku tak ada pilihan selain buat kau jumpa kegelapan.” Clodoveu menyiapkan senjatanya sementara Wilson mengambil baldi.

16b643973657.en: Neferteri stands and hugs her. "As Queen of Sanbi, I hereby relieve you of your research duties." Tears run down her face as the memory of a dead fetus creeps back: Eori was pregnant when Arukia killed her in Vol 3, and when Morika revived her, her body rejected and expelled the fetus. Neferteri saw the corpse of what would have been her first grandchild, and told Morika to dispose of it properly. "I'm sorry, Eori. I should have known."
16b643973657.t: Neferteri berdiri dan memeluknya. “Sebagai Permaisuri Sanbi, beta dengan ini melepaskan anakanda daripada tugas penyelidikan.” Air mata mengalir di wajahnya ketika ingatan tentang janin yang mati menjalar kembali: Eori sedang hamil ketika Arukia membunuhnya dalam Jilid 3, dan apabila Morika menghidupkannya semula, badannya menolak dan mengeluarkan janin itu. Neferteri melihat mayat yang sepatutnya menjadi cucu pertamanya, dan menyuruh Morika menguruskannya dengan sewajarnya. “Maafkan bonda, Eori. Bonda sepatutnya tahu.”

183c9d45f2a2.en: "All right! FINE! SUIT YOURSELF!" Katsumi runs, biting her lips in anger, but her sister's face keeps haunting her. She trips into the mud, too weak to get up, and feels something sharp poke her back.
183c9d45f2a2.t: “Baiklah! OKEY! IKUT SUKA KAU!” Katsumi berlari, menggigit bibirnya kerana marah, tetapi wajah adiknya terus menghantuinya. Dia tersadung ke dalam lumpur, terlalu lemah untuk bangun, dan merasakan sesuatu yang tajam mencucuk belakangnya.

185de30320e3.en: She chews the flowers as the screams and the fight draw closer, lying with her arms wide open, staring vacantly at the ceiling. A loud fire roars outside, followed by a crash against the wall. It doesn't scare her, not even when the bookshelf comes crashing down on her. Her exposed hand shows bits of flower petals as blood pours out.
185de30320e3.t: Dia mengunyah bunga ketika jeritan dan pertarungan semakin dekat, berbaring dengan tangan terbuka luas, merenung kosong ke siling. Api yang kuat menderu di luar, diikuti hentaman ke dinding. Ia tidak menakutkannya, walaupun ketika rak buku runtuh menimpanya. Tangannya yang terdedah menunjukkan cebisan kelopak bunga ketika darah mengalir keluar.

18c01809afdb.en: Huneo goes through the stockpile Gabiro and Kibe left behind and hands her a paper. "First, I want an updated inventory of everything here by the deadline." "That's impossible!" "That's an order. Make it happen." She looks at the guard's hand on his sword and forces herself not to explode.
18c01809afdb.t: Huneo memeriksa stok yang ditinggalkan Gabiro dan Kibe dan menyerahkan sehelai kertas kepadanya. “Pertama, saya mahu inventori terkini semua di sini sebelum tarikh akhir.” “Mustahil!” “Itu perintah. Laksanakan.” Dia memandang tangan pengawal di pedangnya dan memaksa diri supaya tidak meletup.

194a8fd7b913.en: Wilson keeps a makeshift scoreboard, half dozing. Harry feels anger, power, a monster in Clodoveu. The fist lands right on Harry's crossed arms and slams them into his face, knocking him back. His vision flickers; he feels like puking his breakfast when a hand reaches toward him.
194a8fd7b913.t: Wilson menyimpan papan markah buatan sendiri, separuh mengantuk. Harry merasakan kemarahan, kuasa, seekor raksasa dalam diri Clodoveu. Penumbuk itu mendarat tepat di lengan Harry yang bersilang dan menghempasnya ke mukanya sendiri, menjatuhkannya ke belakang. Penglihatannya berkelip; dia rasa nak muntahkan sarapannya apabila sebelah tangan menghulur ke arahnya.

1953363d75e4.en: Dalila's father, Laramy, is an older gentleman. Dalila: "Mom! Can we stop by Jack Wood?" Her mom, Honati, squeezes her round cheeks. "Anything for my little chubby." Dalila, flustered, pushes her hands away. "You're embarrassing me!"
1953363d75e4.t: Bapa Dalila, Laramy, seorang lelaki tua yang budiman. Dalila: “Mak! Boleh kita singgah Jack Wood?” Ibunya, Honati, mencubit pipinya yang bulat. “Apa saja untuk si tembam mak.” Dalila, menggelabah, menolak tangannya. “Mak buat orang malu!”

19e1fb5e6675.en: He can't move. One of the Bagarisas farts. He shakes himself loose and stands up, and realizes the fost stone lamp went out overnight.
19e1fb5e6675.t: Dia tidak boleh bergerak. Seekor Bagarisa kentut. Dia menggoncang diri hingga terlepas dan berdiri, dan sedar lampu fost stone padam semalaman.

1a08a0dea39a.en: "Life is all about eating or getting eaten. Eori ate you plenty of times, but did you ever eat her back?" Harry imagines eating her pussy and laughs. "I guess so?" Clodoveu smirks too. "Let me rephrase. Did you want to eat her? Do you love her?" Harry feels a stab in his heart, not from loneliness, but from fear of what she could do to him if she ever found him. "Hmmm hmm." "There's your answer. Somewhere in this world, you'll find the thing you want to eat most. I already found mine, but he didn't want to eat me back. Now I'm looking for the second-best thing."
1a08a0dea39a.t: “Hidup ni semuanya pasal makan atau dimakan. Eori dah banyak kali ‘makan’ kau, tapi kau pernah ‘makan’ dia balik?” Harry membayangkan menjilat pantatnya dan ketawa. “Rasanya pernah?” Clodoveu tersenyum sinis juga. “Biar aku tanya semula. Kau nak ‘makan’ dia? Kau cintakan dia?” Harry rasa satu tikaman di hatinya, bukan kerana kesunyian, tetapi kerana takut apa yang dia boleh buat kepadanya jika dia pernah menjumpainya. “Hmmm hmm.” “Itulah jawapan kau. Di suatu tempat dalam dunia ni, kau akan jumpa benda yang paling kau nak ‘makan’. Aku dah jumpa milik aku, tapi dia tak nak ‘makan’ aku balik. Sekarang aku tengah cari benda kedua terbaik.”

1ba746dcb010.en: Katsumi drags Katsuki along until Katsuki pulls free and stops dead. "ONE! ENOUGH! TWO! KILL—ME!" Katsumi slaps her and pulls, but she won't budge, and walks toward the oncoming bandits.
1ba746dcb010.t: Katsumi mengheret Katsuki sehingga Katsuki melepaskan diri dan berhenti terpaku. “SATU! CUKUP! DUA! BUNUH—AKU!” Katsumi menamparnya dan menarik, tetapi dia tidak berganjak, dan berjalan ke arah penyamun yang datang.

1ce7303b3c94.en: The door closes. Itagiba: "He's stealing my thunder, honey. I think you were right after all." Neferteri: "I see this as a chance to bring some of those values into our guild." "And end up like your parents? That sucks." "Everything in moderation, my dear. There's a reason I'm here, and not there." Itagiba flexes his beefy arms. "Is it because of these two bad boys?" Neferteri cracks a jovial smile. "There's more to it than that. Now, shall we get on with the day?" "You betcha."
1ce7303b3c94.t: Pintu tertutup. Itagiba: “Dia curi kehebatan kanda, sayang. Kanda rasa dinda betul juga.” Neferteri: “Dinda melihat ini sebagai peluang membawa sebahagian nilai itu ke dalam persatuan kita.” “Dan berakhir macam mak ayah dinda? Teruk tu.” “Segalanya secara sederhana, kanda. Ada sebab dinda di sini, dan bukan di sana.” Itagiba melenturkan lengannya yang tegap. “Sebab dua budak nakal ni ke?” Neferteri mengukir senyuman ceria. “Lebih daripada itu. Sekarang, boleh kita teruskan hari ini?” “Mestilah.”

1d64c561b188.en: Katsumi mouths off and draws the bandits' ire. When she refuses to come work at their farm and they realize the two are Red Winga whores, they draw their swords.
1d64c561b188.t: Katsumi bercakap besar dan membangkitkan kemarahan penyamun itu. Apabila dia enggan datang bekerja di ladang mereka dan mereka sedar dua beradik itu pelacur Red Winga, mereka menghunus pedang.

1db7f1b7ba4c.en: Breathing hard, he feels the pain the adrenaline had been holding back dequeue into his mind all at once. His feet are the worst: they've been leaking blood for a while, leaving a trail that quickly blends into the sea of leaves on the chilly wind.
1db7f1b7ba4c.t: Tercungap-cungap, dia merasakan kesakitan yang ditahan adrenalin selama ini keluar dari baris gilir ke dalam mindanya serentak. Kakinya paling teruk: ia sudah lama mengalirkan darah, meninggalkan jejak yang cepat bercampur dengan lautan daun dalam angin dingin.

1e54d6d88b18.en: Harry wakes to a Bagarisa kissing him and pushes it away, screaming: they kind of stink. It oinks at him, as if complaining about the bad treatment.
1e54d6d88b18.t: Harry bangun dengan seekor Bagarisa sedang menciumnya dan menolaknya sambil menjerit: mereka agak busuk. Ia mendengus kepadanya, seolah-olah mengadu tentang layanan buruk itu.

1ef7434d628a.en: Neferteri: from now on, they'll let the quest go stale and give her daughter's heart time to heal. Their next orders: find Harry and Sinoi. All three are to go fully back to their adventurer roles and cast a wide net across the kingdom. She hands out the only badge they have, which is Harry's, and cuts their stipend in half: the new courtroom scientist is relentless about probing Eiri for spending records.
1ef7434d628a.t: Neferteri: mulai sekarang, mereka akan membiarkan misi itu basi dan memberi masa untuk hati anaknya pulih. Arahan seterusnya: cari Harry dan Sinoi. Ketiga-tiga mereka perlu kembali sepenuhnya kepada peranan pengembara dan menebar jaring luas di seluruh kerajaan. Dia menyerahkan satu-satunya lencana yang mereka ada, iaitu milik Harry, dan memotong elaun mereka separuh: saintis istana yang baharu tidak henti-henti menyiasat Eiri tentang rekod perbelanjaan.

1f0392960420.en: Itagiba and Neferteri, one on one

1f4cacb24a9f.en: Harry hesitates; Marcus stabs him in the shoulder. "I'm not fucking around! Where is {WIP-oldHagLootHouse}?" Clodoveu taps Marcus's shoulder, and Marcus shoves him off. "Fuck off, you fag. I'm talking here." Clodoveu raises his hands and sits down. Marcus grips the mohawk so tight Harry feels his scalp coming unglued.
1f4cacb24a9f.t: Harry teragak-agak; Marcus menikam bahunya. “Aku tak main-main! Mana {WIP-oldHagLootHouse}?” Clodoveu menepuk bahu Marcus, dan Marcus menolaknya. “Blah la, pondan. Aku tengah bercakap.” Clodoveu mengangkat tangan dan duduk. Marcus mencengkam mohawk itu begitu kuat hingga Harry rasa kulit kepalanya tercabut.

1f83626049d8.en: Kibe: "I'm out." Someone in the crowd: "Man! You suck!" A tall, strong Darfaries: "Yeah! I'll give you an Amethyst if you can suck me as much as you sucked at this job! Hahaha!" Kibe pauses, almost as if taking a mental picture of him, before leaving the stage.
1f83626049d8.t: Kibe: “Aku blah.” Seseorang dalam orang ramai: “Weh! Kau teruk!” Seorang Darfaries yang tinggi dan kuat: “Ya! Aku bagi kau sebiji Amethyst kalau kau boleh hisap aku seteruk kau buat kerja ni! Hahaha!” Kibe berhenti sejenak, hampir seperti merakam gambarnya dalam kepala, sebelum meninggalkan pentas.

1ff45ed70cf9.en: "I never agreed to anything like that." Eori, slouched in her chair with her arms crossed, draws everyone's attention, and her mother's disapproving look. Neferteri: "This is no longer a matter of agreeing, but of doing." "THEN I DON'T WANNA DO IT!" She heads out.
1ff45ed70cf9.t: “Aku tak pernah setuju dengan apa-apa macam tu.” Eori, terlentok di kerusinya dengan tangan bersilang, menarik perhatian semua orang, dan pandangan tidak bersetuju ibunya. Neferteri: “Ini bukan lagi soal bersetuju, tetapi soal melakukan.” “KALAU MACAM TU AKU TAK NAK BUAT!” Dia menuju keluar.

211f00b05d57.en: Katsumi smiles at him. "So you wanna see my new special move?" "Ohh, yeah? I'll be waiting." He smacks his lips and walks off light-footed, as if he'd just won the lottery. "I promise you won't forget it." He rubs his crotch. "I'm gonna skip the booze to give you my special ability too." Katsumi keeps smiling. Shit. I might've pushed it too far.
211f00b05d57.t: Katsumi tersenyum kepadanya. “Jadi kau nak tengok gerakan istimewa baharu aku?” “Ohh, ye ke? Aku tunggu.” Dia mengecap bibir dan berjalan pergi dengan langkah ringan, seolah-olah baru menang loteri. “Aku janji kau takkan lupa.” Dia menggosok kelangkangnya. “Aku takkan minum arak supaya boleh bagi kau kebolehan istimewa aku juga.” Katsumi terus tersenyum. Celaka. Mungkin aku dah terlebih.

21f1d37a8f90.en: Eori shuts down. "I need to find Harry first." Maiara loses it. "All right, that's it! He was supposed to be MY husband!" "He's not!" "Yeah? Then why are you so obsessed with him?" "I AM NOT! HE'S A NO—I WANT HIM AS A RESEARCH ASSISTANT!"
21f1d37a8f90.t: Eori menutup diri. “Aku perlu cari Harry dulu.” Maiara naik angin. “Okey, cukup! Dia sepatutnya suami AKU!” “Bukan!” “Ye ke? Habis kenapa kau taksub sangat dengan dia?” “AKU TAK! DIA BU—AKU NAK DIA JADI PEMBANTU PENYELIDIKAN!”

22e8027cecaa.en: Arc #2 - Hifuna Beast: the author's story notes (spoilers).
22e8027cecaa.t: Arka #2 - Makhluk Buas Hifuna: nota cerita pengarang (bocoran).

22ed03f88caa.en: Wrapped in a cloth against the cold, Harry smells the freshly cooked, seasoned meat wrapped in cornmeal, and his stomach growls violently, but the image of the dead Bagarisas makes him ill. He turns his head. Marcus: "I wish I had friends this good." He eats the meat right in front of Harry, savoring the juiciness. Harry flares up again.
22ed03f88caa.t: Berbalut kain menahan sejuk, Harry menghidu daging berperasa yang baru dimasak berbalut tepung jagung, dan perutnya berkeroncong hebat, tetapi bayangan Bagarisa yang mati membuatnya loya. Dia memalingkan kepala. Marcus: “Aku harap aku ada kawan sebaik ni.” Dia makan daging itu tepat di depan Harry, menikmati jusnya. Harry menyala lagi.

22ee764ba13f.en: Eori's anger rises as she seems to realize she has lost her last defense. Now everyone has turned on her, and on Harry.
22ee764ba13f.t: Kemarahan Eori memuncak ketika dia seolah-olah sedar dia telah kehilangan pertahanan terakhirnya. Sekarang semua orang telah berpaling daripadanya, dan daripada Harry.

24fff589839c.en: Sora gasps. "Then how did she have time to make all those nari gels, being that lovey-dovey?" "It's all about love—and you lost your chance, since he's not coming back for a maid." Sora turns red with shame. "Still rubs you the wrong way? Then ask him to rub you the right way." Eiri laughs, but it ends in a sad smile, remembering how she coerced Harry into signing the contract. I'm sorry, Harry. I hope you decided to flee it all instead… She has a guard escort Sora back to the dormitory: she has a few things to talk about with Eori.
24fff589839c.t: Sora tersentak. “Habis macam mana dia ada masa buat semua nari gel tu, sambil bermesra-mesraan?” “Semuanya pasal cinta—dan kau dah terlepas peluang, sebab dia takkan balik untuk seorang pembantu rumah.” Sora menjadi merah kerana malu. “Masih rasa tak kena? Minta dia belai kau dengan betul, kalau macam tu.” Eiri ketawa, tetapi ia berakhir dengan senyuman sedih, teringat bagaimana dia memaksa Harry menandatangani kontrak itu. Maafkan aku, Harry. Aku harap kau memilih untuk lari daripada semua ni… Dia menyuruh seorang pengawal mengiringi Sora balik ke asrama: dia ada beberapa perkara nak dibincangkan dengan Eori.

255b70271289.en: An adventurer sends the Winga up. It flies above the trees, looks around, and barks over and over as it heads back. "Speed it up! Something dangerous is coming!" "I can't go any faster!" "I'm gonna Create Hail." The other adventurer: "All right. I'll Decrease Gravity on the cart, then get a shock ready." They do; the Winga's barking grows louder and faster.
255b70271289.t: Seorang pengembara melepaskan Winga ke atas. Ia terbang di atas pokok, meninjau, dan menyalak berulang kali ketika kembali. “Laju lagi! Sesuatu yang bahaya sedang datang!” “Tak boleh laju lagi dah!” “Aku nak Create Hail.” Pengembara yang lagi seorang: “Okey. Aku Decrease Gravity pada kereta, kemudian siapkan kejutan.” Mereka berbuat begitu; salakan Winga menjadi lebih kuat dan laju.

271769f39b6a.en: A knock: Eiri. "Hey, got time to spare?" "I'm busy." "All right, all right. I came to ask about Harry." Eori turns. "What do you want?" "So what was your relationship with him? Did you break up with him, or what?"
271769f39b6a.t: Ketukan: Eiri. “Hei, ada masa lapang?” “Aku sibuk.” “Okey, okey. Aku datang nak tanya pasal Harry.” Eori berpaling. “Kau nak apa?” “Jadi apa hubungan kau dengan dia? Kau putus dengan dia ke, atau apa?”

27883fc55be5.en: Everyone approves except Neferteri, who drills Huneo with questions. Eiri asks if she suspects him; Neferteri says it's all happening too fast.
27883fc55be5.t: Semua orang meluluskan kecuali Neferteri, yang menyoal Huneo bertubi-tubi. Eiri bertanya sama ada dia mencurigainya; Neferteri kata semuanya berlaku terlalu cepat.

28d376c6fcf9.en: {WIP-maginafarmBoss} steps back, and an explosion sends him (or rather a chunk of him) and everyone around flying in all directions. The pressure wave destroys everything else, while putting out all the flames. Everything grows quiet.
28d376c6fcf9.t: {WIP-maginafarmBoss} berundur, dan satu letupan menghantarnya (atau lebih tepat seketul dirinya) dan semua orang di sekeliling terbang ke segala arah. Gelombang tekanan memusnahkan segala yang lain, sambil memadamkan semua api. Segalanya menjadi sunyi.

2b8aec035b77.en: "See? I told ya, it's just a matter of connecting the dots. Now, Sora, can you put some sense into Eiri and stop her Big Momma behavior?" Sora still can't swallow it. "Then why didn't Arukia ever contact us?" "Why would she? I'd find it weird if she suddenly wasn't private about her life."
2b8aec035b77.t: “Nampak? Aku dah cakap, cuma soal sambungkan titik. Sekarang, Sora, boleh tak kau sedarkan Eiri dan hentikan perangai Mak Besar dia?” Sora masih tak boleh telan. “Habis kenapa Arukia tak pernah hubungi kita?” “Kenapa dia nak buat macam tu? Aku rasa pelik kalau dia tiba-tiba tak berahsia pasal hidup dia.”

2c43660cbd0f.en: "Hey, fuckface! Can't you see they're Red Winga property?" "So what? They're whores anyway!" "Red Winga whores! Can't you imagine how much info they have?" "And?" "And we can get information out of them, you retarded Brunto. Let's go! I knew I'd spotted gold."
2c43660cbd0f.t: “Hoi, muka pantat! Kau tak nampak ke mereka harta Red Winga?” “Jadi apa? Pelacur juga!” “Pelacur Red Winga! Kau tak boleh bayang ke berapa banyak maklumat yang mereka ada?” “Dan?” “Dan kita boleh korek maklumat daripada mereka, kau Brunto bebal terencat. Jom! Aku tahu aku dah jumpa emas.”

2e15405cdcd8.en: Itagiba asks if they're doing the right thing with Eori. Neferteri says it'll keep her mind busy: she needs to forget Harry. Itagiba wonders whether forcing her into a position is best for her. Neferteri says she knows best, and won't let the same emotional outbursts happen to Eori.
2e15405cdcd8.t: Itagiba bertanya sama ada mereka melakukan perkara yang betul dengan Eori. Neferteri kata ia akan menyibukkan fikirannya: dia perlu melupakan Harry. Itagiba tertanya-tanya sama ada memaksanya ke satu jawatan adalah yang terbaik untuknya. Neferteri kata dia paling tahu, dan tidak akan membiarkan ledakan emosi yang sama berlaku kepada Eori.

2ee62d5abbd4.en: Blood drips from her. She blinks, and Harry is gone; she tries to find him, but her eyes are too fuzzy. She blinks again, and sees wild animals eating her parents.
2ee62d5abbd4.t: Darah menitis daripadanya. Dia berkelip, dan Harry sudah tiada; dia cuba mencarinya, tetapi matanya terlalu kabur. Dia berkelip lagi, dan nampak haiwan liar memakan ibu bapanya.

30d8891f83d6.en: "So, about Kozaku. Why does he look like that?" "Walking Heart. Never heard of them?" Harry shakes his head. "That's why he had a flame on his heart. It looks like your flame, but the interface is totally different." "So he was a scientific experiment?" "Oh, no. He sought out one of those stones in the Hifuna region and replaced his heart with it, and once it was in, it melded with him. Now he's not really a Darfaries, more like a Walking Flathead." "What?" "Never heard of them either? Were you born yesterday?" Harry laughs. "I only remember things since summer, so kind of."
30d8891f83d6.t: “Jadi, pasal Kozaku. Kenapa dia nampak macam tu?” “Walking Heart. Tak pernah dengar?” Harry menggeleng. “Sebab tulah ada api di jantungnya. Nampak macam api kau, tapi antara mukanya lain sama sekali.” “Jadi dia eksperimen sains?” “Oh, tak. Dia cari salah satu batu tu di rantau Hifuna dan ganti jantungnya dengannya, dan sebaik ia masuk, ia bergabung dengannya. Sekarang dia bukan betul-betul Darfaries, lebih macam Walking Flathead.” “Apa?” “Tak pernah dengar pasal tu juga? Kau lahir semalam ke?” Harry ketawa. “Aku cuma ingat benda sejak musim panas, jadi lebih kurang.”

31115fe51886.en: Eori points at the office next door, the king and queen of Sanbi's. "They said no to raising it too?" Eiri slowly nods, with a hum that confirms Eori's suspicion. Eori turns to leave without a word; her anger seems to make the room's gravity heavier. "Wait! Please keep this between us, okay?" Eori glances back with bloodthirsty eyes, then leaves without a word.
31115fe51886.t: Eori menuding pejabat di sebelah, pejabat raja dan permaisuri Sanbi. “Mereka pun kata tak nak naikkan?” Eiri mengangguk perlahan, dengan dengungan yang mengesahkan syak Eori. Eori berpaling untuk beredar tanpa sepatah kata; kemarahannya seolah-olah memberatkan graviti bilik itu. “Tunggu! Tolong rahsiakan ni antara kita, okey?” Eori menoleh dengan mata dahagakan darah, kemudian beredar tanpa sepatah kata.

311d650285c6.en: Neferteri calmly applauds. "Thank you, Princess Nina. Based on y—" Eori feels the end of the line coming; she bursts into tears, crying like a child caught stealing candy.
311d650285c6.t: Neferteri bertepuk tangan dengan tenang. “Terima kasih, Puteri Nina. Berdasarkan a—” Eori dapat rasa penghujungnya tiba; dia meledak menangis, menangis seperti budak yang ditangkap mencuri gula-gula.

311d65894514.en: A piercing jab plows through his stomach. Behind him, a ghostly white figure smirks. He forces his flat right hand through that shit-eating smile and deep into its mouth, feels something spongy and warm calling to be grabbed and pulled, and does. The smile turns to pure agony.
311d65894514.t: Satu tikaman tajam menembusi perutnya. Di belakangnya, susuk putih seperti hantu tersenyum sinis. Dia memaksa tangan kanannya yang leper menembusi senyuman celaka itu dan jauh ke dalam mulutnya, merasakan sesuatu yang lembut berspan dan hangat memanggil untuk digenggam dan ditarik, dan dia melakukannya. Senyuman itu bertukar menjadi derita tulen.

316169bc2b0f.en: Harry and the Bagarisas are getting each other's rhythm. Two Bagarisas die in the fight, and the others revive them. Harry uses the Bagarisas' exploding forward power.
316169bc2b0f.t: Harry dan Bagarisa semakin serasi rentak antara satu sama lain. Dua ekor Bagarisa mati dalam pertarungan, dan yang lain menghidupkan mereka semula. Harry menggunakan kuasa letupan ke depan Bagarisa.

31d0409cc6f6.en: "Hey, Nefi, is everything all right?" Neferteri stands and hugs her husband. "Of course it is. You're here with me."
31d0409cc6f6.t: “Hei, Nefi, semuanya okey?” Neferteri berdiri dan memeluk suaminya. “Sudah tentu. Kanda ada di sini bersama dinda.”

320be71e1494.en: Huneo buys their answers in the end, but still won't raise the reward for Harry, and demands control of the budget. Neferteri agrees, to push the idea that she isn't so closely tied to Harry; Itagiba goes along; Eiri refuses, but she's outvoted. She holds back her emotions and moves on to the next topic.
320be71e1494.t: Huneo akhirnya menerima jawapan mereka, tetapi tetap tidak mahu menaikkan ganjaran untuk Harry, dan menuntut kawalan bajet. Neferteri bersetuju, untuk menolak tanggapan bahawa dia tidak begitu rapat berkait dengan Harry; Itagiba ikut sama; Eiri menolak, tetapi dia kalah undi. Dia menahan emosinya dan beralih ke topik seterusnya.

3228314ad3fc.en: Wide-eyed, Eiri has listened to everything; Sora is asleep against Aurora. "I just can't believe it. I want to, but I don't. Hmmmm. It does explain why Neferteri was so willing to call a search quest for Harry, and even to have me get him to sign the contract. She loves Eori the most, after all." Eiri spills everything she knows.
3228314ad3fc.t: Dengan mata terbeliak, Eiri sudah mendengar segalanya; Sora tertidur bersandar pada Aurora. “Aku tak percaya. Aku nak percaya, tapi tak boleh. Hmmmm. Memang menjelaskan kenapa Neferteri begitu sanggup buat misi pencarian untuk Harry, malah suruh aku dapatkan dia tandatangan kontrak. Dia paling sayangkan Eori, lagipun.” Eiri membongkar semua yang dia tahu.

3245f3c01910.en: "You don't look like someone who wants to die, but I can tell you already have." Clodoveu sets his weapon aside and sits. "Want to know what a Hifuna beast is? Go near Hifuna, and you'll see all kinds of strange beasts. Most are animals we eat, turned into monsters from living out there. A friend of mine went to loot dead adventurers and never came back. But you—I don't think you're a Hifuna beast. Did you sell yourself to a scientist?"
3245f3c01910.t: “Kau tak nampak macam orang yang nak mati, tapi aku boleh tahu kau dah pernah mati.” Clodoveu meletakkan senjatanya ke tepi dan duduk. “Nak tahu apa itu Hifuna beast? Pergi dekat Hifuna, dan kau akan nampak macam-macam makhluk buas pelik. Kebanyakannya haiwan yang kita makan, bertukar jadi raksasa sebab hidup di sana. Seorang kawan aku pergi rompak pengembara yang mati dan tak pernah balik. Tapi kau—aku rasa kau bukan Hifuna beast. Kau jual diri kau kepada saintis ke?”

32bece148f77.en: He screams, tackles a Wozen from behind, and his hand lights up, burning it alive; he kills it by burning its face and mouth.
32bece148f77.t: Dia menjerit, menerkam seekor Wozen dari belakang, dan tangannya menyala, membakarnya hidup-hidup; dia membunuhnya dengan membakar muka dan mulutnya.

33ff0bcdf78e.en: Katsuki pulls away and starts walking back. Katsumi grabs her. "Too late now! Harry's dead meat! He's not gonna survive the night."
33ff0bcdf78e.t: Katsuki menarik diri dan mula berjalan balik. Katsumi menangkapnya. “Dah terlambat! Harry dah jadi daging busuk! Dia takkan hidup sampai pagi.”

35cdee85b8e7.en: "I am the Queen of Sanbi, but above all, I'm the mother of four princesses. I trusted you with an important task despite my doubts about your ability to care for others. But your inability to control your emotions turned out just as unacceptable as Maiara's… and Yacamim's." They stare each other down, until Neferteri closes her eyes. "Princess Nina, please come in."
35cdee85b8e7.t: “Beta Permaisuri Sanbi, tetapi lebih daripada itu, beta ibu kepada empat orang puteri. Beta mempercayakan anakanda tugas penting walaupun beta ragu dengan kebolehan anakanda menjaga orang lain. Tetapi ketidakupayaan anakanda mengawal emosi ternyata sama tidak boleh diterimanya seperti Maiara… dan Yacamim.” Mereka saling merenung, sehingga Neferteri memejamkan mata. “Puteri Nina, sila masuk.”

3710de2bbc7e.en: Aurora slowly backs away. "OH NO! You come back here!" "I'm sorry, Princess, but I'm not sure what to say about this." "What? It's dead simple! I asked for Harry! He's mine!" "Asked?" Eori: "No! He's mine! You won the battle, which means you lost Harry!" "But that doesn't mean he's yours!"
3710de2bbc7e.t: Aurora perlahan-lahan berundur. “OH TAK! Kau datang balik sini!” “Maaf, Tuan Puteri, tapi saya tak pasti nak cakap apa tentang hal ini.” “Apa? Senang saja! Aku yang minta Harry! Dia milik aku!” “Minta?” Eori: “Tak! Dia milik aku! Kau menang pertarungan, maknanya kau kehilangan Harry!” “Tapi tak bermakna dia milik kau!”

3796a9873bf6.en: Marcus: "We're close to Forkpoint." Clodoveu pulls the wagon over. "Let's put on fake bodies. Harry, you ready?" "I guess so." Clodoveu hands him a nari gel bottle with Bagarisa fur, eyes and more in it. Harry gulps. Marcus: "I'm gonna force it down your throat if you don't." Clodoveu: "Give him some time. Some people aren't good at swallowing." Marcus narrows his eyes, but says nothing.
3796a9873bf6.t: Marcus: “Kita dah dekat Forkpoint.” Clodoveu memberhentikan gerabak di tepi. “Jom pakai badan palsu. Harry, kau dah sedia?” “Rasanya.” Clodoveu menghulurkan sebotol nari gel berisi bulu Bagarisa, mata dan lain-lain. Harry menelan air liur. Marcus: “Aku sumbat dalam tekak kau kalau kau tak nak.” Clodoveu: “Beri dia masa. Sesetengah orang tak pandai menelan.” Marcus mengecilkan mata, tetapi tidak berkata apa-apa.

37f46f8e27b2.en: This new life isn't so bad, he thinks: he's free to do anything, and nobody hurts him. Something bites, but he doesn't set the hook, and the bait is stolen. He slaps on a new chunk of meat and casts as hard as he can.
37f46f8e27b2.t: Hidup baharu ini tidak teruk sangat, fikirnya: dia bebas buat apa saja, dan tiada siapa menyakitinya. Sesuatu menggigit, tetapi dia tidak menyentap mata kail, dan umpannya dicuri. Dia mencucuk seketul daging baharu dan melontar sekuat hatinya.

38c40032b71e.en: A Darfaries bandit girl steps out of the shadows
38c40032b71e.t: Seorang gadis penyamun Darfaries melangkah keluar dari bayang-bayang

38f26614b47a.en: Sora gets flustered and looks away in shame. Eiri: "Nobody told you?" "About what?" Eiri waves her in to close the door. Eori does, but doesn't sit; she stands a few feet away, glaring at them both.
38f26614b47a.t: Sora menggelabah dan memandang ke arah lain kerana malu. Eiri: “Tak ada siapa beritahu kau?” “Pasal apa?” Eiri melambai menyuruhnya masuk dan menutup pintu. Eori berbuat begitu, tetapi tidak duduk; dia berdiri beberapa kaki jauhnya, menjeling mereka berdua.

39fb564ac7c0.en: Neferteri tells Nina that Eori has been behaving badly, and she needs all the support she can get. Nina says she'll help, then asks why they're hiding behind nari gel.
39fb564ac7c0.t: Neferteri memberitahu Nina bahawa Eori berkelakuan buruk, dan dia perlukan semua sokongan yang boleh didapatinya. Nina kata dia akan membantu, kemudian bertanya kenapa mereka bersembunyi di sebalik nari gel.

3a22d7c05f81.en: Katsumi, in the bandit's clothes, in a small cave with a fost lamp
3a22d7c05f81.t: Katsumi, dalam pakaian penyamun itu, di dalam gua kecil dengan lampu fost

3a5258ba48e9.en: In a few blinks, a red sea of blood pools around the bandit, and his life flashes away. Katsumi gets up and spits in his face. "See? I told ya it was something special."
3a5258ba48e9.t: Dalam beberapa kelipan mata, lautan darah merah bertakung di sekeliling penyamun itu, dan nyawanya melayang pergi. Katsumi bangun dan meludah mukanya. “Nampak? Aku dah cakap ia sesuatu yang istimewa.”

3b561f9b8119.en: "Maiara learned her lesson. I still think Eori should live and learn. There's a reason we have Forway laws." "Let me handle her. She'll be a shining example." "All right. If you feel that strongly about it, have it your way. Just cut them some slack once in a while."
3b561f9b8119.t: “Maiara dah belajar daripada kesilapannya. Kanda masih rasa Eori patut hidup dan belajar. Ada sebab kita ada undang-undang Forway.” “Biar dinda uruskan dia. Dia akan jadi contoh yang cemerlang.” “Baiklah. Kalau dinda rasa begitu kuat tentangnya, ikut cara dinda. Cuma longgarkan sikit sekali-sekala.”

3b9be63a2329.en: Harry and the Bagarisas settle in to sleep, full
3b9be63a2329.t: Harry dan Bagarisa bersiap untuk tidur, kenyang

3beb9f166d2e.en: Memories of Katsumi and Katsuki, of Eori and everyone else. Another bite: he sets the hook and pulls in a fish, and the Bagarisas oink like crazy. He cooks the fish in his hands, pulls it apart and tosses it to them, and they go crazy slurping it up.
3beb9f166d2e.t: Ingatan tentang Katsumi dan Katsuki, tentang Eori dan semua orang lain. Satu lagi gigitan: dia menyentap dan menarik naik seekor ikan, dan Bagarisa mendengus macam gila. Dia memasak ikan itu di tangannya, mencarik-cariknya dan melemparkannya kepada mereka, dan mereka menghirupnya dengan rakus.

3c57dec66244.en: Something drops behind him, squeezes him tight and lifts him off the ground, sniffing him deeply, like a fat guy with a fried chicken he just bought. The breath tickles his neck and he laughs. "You're just like Desmond!" says a familiar voice in his ear, her bristly fur rubbing him and making him laugh even harder.
3c57dec66244.t: Sesuatu jatuh di belakangnya, memeluknya erat dan mengangkatnya dari tanah, menghidunya dalam-dalam, macam lelaki gemuk dengan ayam goreng yang baru dibelinya. Nafas itu menggeletek lehernya dan dia ketawa. “Kau sama macam Desmond!” kata suara yang biasa didengar di telinganya, bulunya yang kasar menggosoknya dan membuatnya ketawa lebih kuat.

402275734e6f.en: He walks toward Harry, who watches him warily, readies a fireball and launches it. Clodoveu shifts his belly aside and raises his arm; the ball flies past, burning his skin, and explodes in the distance, searing his back and hair. His wounds stop healing. He touches his hair. "I'm all out of healing now. Dammit. Well, you asked for it!"
402275734e6f.t: Dia berjalan ke arah Harry, yang memerhatinya dengan berhati-hati, menyiapkan bebola api dan melepaskannya. Clodoveu mengalihkan perutnya ke tepi dan mengangkat lengan; bebola itu melintas, membakar kulitnya, dan meletup di kejauhan, menghanguskan belakang dan rambutnya. Lukanya berhenti sembuh. Dia menyentuh rambutnya. “Penyembuhan aku dah habis. Celaka. Yalah, kau yang minta!”

418857ecb413.en: Neferteri and Nina, back at Sanbi Castle
418857ecb413.t: Neferteri dan Nina, kembali di Sanbi Castle

426cfe102cdc.en: He watches the sun rise over the forest, but his mind drifts to everyone he has betrayed: he broke his promise to Eiri, he let the Bagarisas die, and now he's about to steal from someone. His heart squeezes. Is this what I really want? But what else can I do? I don't know anyone!
426cfe102cdc.t: Dia memerhati matahari terbit di atas hutan, tetapi fikirannya melayang kepada semua orang yang telah dikhianatinya: dia memungkiri janjinya kepada Eiri, dia membiarkan Bagarisa mati, dan sekarang dia akan mencuri daripada seseorang. Hatinya terhimpit. Inikah yang aku betul-betul nak? Tapi apa lagi boleh aku buat? Aku tak kenal sesiapa!

43195101199d.en: Hiromi laughs it off. "My bad, I guess. I just remember her being innocent. I haven't really talked to her in years." "If you laid off the booze every time we went to the castle, you'd probably remember something, you fat cunt." "You're drinking too, cut the crap." "Fuck you! You're the one emptying our home stockpile!" "Fuck that! Fuck you!" He stands and pumps his arm, calling her out for a throwdown.
43195101199d.t: Hiromi ketawa saja. “Salah aku, kot. Aku cuma ingat dia dulu naif. Dah bertahun aku tak betul-betul bercakap dengan dia.” “Kalau kau kurangkan arak setiap kali kita pergi istana, mungkin kau ingat sesuatu, kau pantat gemuk.” “Kau pun minum, jangan merepek.” “Kena main kau! Kau yang habiskan stok rumah kita!” “Celaka! Kena main kau!” Dia berdiri dan mengepam lengan, mencabarnya bertumbuk.

4358649ccd5d.en: Out of pure spite, Eori injects herself with nari, catching Huneo and his guard off guard. She attacks the guard, who can barely defend himself and tells Huneo to run. He doesn't. Eori sends the guard flying, incapacitating him.
4358649ccd5d.t: Kerana dendam semata-mata, Eori menyuntik dirinya dengan nari, mengejutkan Huneo dan pengawalnya. Dia menyerang pengawal itu, yang hampir tidak dapat mempertahankan diri dan menyuruh Huneo lari. Huneo tidak lari. Eori menghantar pengawal itu terbang, melumpuhkannya.

435e94827567.en: A Bagarisa heals Harry, and he cuddles it. "Thank you! I love you guys!" Happy oinks. Then he gets sad again: he's still stuck in the forest.
435e94827567.t: Seekor Bagarisa menyembuhkan Harry, dan dia memeluknya. “Terima kasih! Aku sayang korang!” Dengusan gembira. Kemudian dia sedih lagi: dia masih tersangkut di hutan.

43b3ba3d6b24.en: Wozen fur covers her skin and eyes. Wilson props himself in the hallway doorway, hands on his stomach. "Great timing, Wilson. Come in and have a seat," says the half-woman, half-Wozen. Marcus: "So what's the plan?" "Slow down. First, how's your belly feeling?" The smirk between her sharp teeth entrances Harry: he has never seen anything like it.
43b3ba3d6b24.t: Bulu Wozen menutupi kulit dan matanya. Wilson menyandar di ambang pintu lorong, tangan di perut. “Masa yang tepat, Wilson. Masuk dan duduk,” kata wanita separuh Wozen itu. Marcus: “Jadi apa rancangannya?” “Perlahan sikit. Pertama, macam mana perut kau?” Senyuman sinis di celah giginya yang tajam memukau Harry: dia tidak pernah melihat apa-apa seperti itu.

449c3ce8c116.en: If enough people ever harass Deo into finishing the story, these notes are the base, changed only as much as needed to keep everything lore-accurate. Most of this was written before Arc 1's notes were fully expanded into the published books, so Vols 1 to 4 are the lore-accurate version wherever they conflict. There's a lot to keep track of, almost as if someone decided to challenge themselves a bit too much, for fun…
449c3ce8c116.t: Kalau cukup ramai orang mendesak Deo menghabiskan cerita ini, nota-nota inilah asasnya, diubah hanya sebanyak yang perlu supaya semuanya tepat dengan lore. Kebanyakannya ditulis sebelum nota Arka 1 dikembangkan sepenuhnya menjadi buku yang diterbitkan, jadi Jilid 1 hingga 4 ialah versi yang tepat dengan lore di mana-mana yang bercanggah. Banyak benda yang perlu dijejaki, seolah-olah ada orang yang memutuskan untuk mencabar diri sendiri lebih sedikit daripada sepatutnya, saja suka-suka…

465ddca95f0d.en: Harry takes a deep breath and eats the jelly in gulps. His body splits open in a fissure as blood and a white soul flame pour out. He screams in pain as his voice drops, hoarse, Bagarisa-like; tusks grow from his face, and one of his arms swells. Marcus grabs his knives. "What the fuck?" Harry lets out a massive shriek that makes the forest tremble in fear. Marcus throws a knife right into its forehead. It looks at Marcus with hanger in its eyes.
465ddca95f0d.t: Harry menarik nafas dalam-dalam dan makan jeli itu dengan rakus. Badannya terbelah dalam satu rekahan ketika darah dan api jiwa putih mencurah keluar. Dia menjerit kesakitan ketika suaranya menjadi garau, serak, seperti Bagarisa; taring tumbuh dari mukanya, dan sebelah lengannya membengkak. Marcus mencapai pisaunya. “Apa celaka?” Harry melepaskan jeritan nyaring yang besar yang membuat hutan bergegar ketakutan. Marcus membaling sebilah pisau tepat ke dahinya. Ia memandang Marcus dengan kelaparan di matanya.

471d6b5f96bb.en: The others, a female among them, cast a spell at the foliage to curse the fruit down. One crashes onto Harry's hand and lands by his groin. Remembering the last fruit, he watches the Bagarisas eat first, only the white inside, then follows suit, and almost cums from how good it is. Together, they strip the tree bare.
471d6b5f96bb.t: Yang lain, seekor betina antaranya, melempar jampi ke arah dedaun untuk menyumpah buah-buah itu jatuh. Sebiji terhempas ke tangan Harry dan jatuh di celah kelangkangnya. Teringat buah yang lepas, dia memerhati Bagarisa makan dulu, hanya isi putihnya, kemudian ikut sama, dan hampir terpancut kerana betapa sedapnya. Bersama-sama, mereka melondehkan pokok itu sampai licin.

477bcd023dc3.en: Ryo spots a girl stumbling through the forest like a zombie, in the afternoon
477bcd023dc3.t: Ryo ternampak seorang gadis terhuyung-hayang melalui hutan seperti zombi, pada waktu petang

4861c77d3242.en: They talk it over, and the adventurer helps with gravity control. Katsumi pulls out her sister Katsuki's body, and they leave. Ryo tries to grab some stuff, but the adventurer refuses: that's too much. Ryo says fine, and they head off to Forway.
4861c77d3242.t: Mereka berbincang, dan pengembara itu membantu dengan kawalan graviti. Katsumi menarik keluar mayat adiknya Katsuki, dan mereka beredar. Ryo cuba mengambil beberapa barang, tetapi pengembara itu menolak: itu keterlaluan. Ryo kata baiklah, dan mereka menuju ke Forway.

48812a79a289.en: "All right, I'll tell you more if you give me a massage." Clodoveu winks. Harry raises his hands in defense, his brain playing a short horror movie of him touching Clodoveu's body. Marcus, under his breath: "Buttfuckers."
48812a79a289.t: “Okey, aku cerita lagi kalau kau urut aku.” Clodoveu mengenyit mata. Harry mengangkat tangan mempertahankan diri, otaknya memainkan filem seram pendek dirinya menyentuh badan Clodoveu. Marcus, berbisik: “Kaki main bontot.”

489631504e5b.en: Harry #8-C after dinner, late at night, around the campfire
489631504e5b.t: Harry #8-C selepas makan malam, lewat malam, di sekeliling unggun api

48ac0bf31fc3.en: Eiri goes on the defensive. "But this is for the better! We lost Arukia!" Silence; Sora peeks out of the pillow with teary eyes, then hides again. "I thought you always told me everything! Sora! I don't want to hurt you! Or you two! Why didn't anybody say anything?" Itanema: "Because you only ever believe Sora anyway."
48ac0bf31fc3.t: Eiri menjadi defensif. “Tapi ini untuk kebaikan! Kita dah kehilangan Arukia!” Senyap; Sora mengintai dari bantal dengan mata berair, kemudian bersembunyi lagi. “Aku ingat kau selalu beritahu aku semuanya! Sora! Aku tak nak sakiti kau! Atau korang berdua! Kenapa tak ada siapa cakap apa-apa?” Itanema: “Sebab kau cuma percaya Sora saja pun.”

48b958ea76a3.en: The sisters and the Black Magina man
48b958ea76a3.t: Adik-beradik itu dan lelaki Black Magina

4925b3d4992f.en: Clodoveu: "So yeah. We were on our own for at least 5 to 7 years before the Blue Wozens poached us." Harry: "So how did you guys meet?" Clodoveu tells their backstory: all three are from Big-Gyut, in the Freeish Kingdom, and they started out young and dumb, a mix of peer pressure, rebellion and immaturity. Wilson laughs. Marcus stands up, faces away from the wagon and pees off the road. Clodoveu keeps going.
4925b3d4992f.t: Clodoveu: “Jadi ya. Kami bergerak sendiri sekurang-kurangnya 5 hingga 7 tahun sebelum Blue Wozens rembat kami.” Harry: “Jadi macam mana korang jumpa?” Clodoveu menceritakan latar belakang mereka: ketiga-tiganya dari Big-Gyut, di Kerajaan Freeish, dan mereka bermula muda dan bodoh, campuran tekanan rakan sebaya, pemberontakan dan ketidakmatangan. Wilson ketawa. Marcus berdiri, membelakangi gerabak dan kencing di tepi jalan. Clodoveu terus bercerita.

499f919a471c.en: Chapter 5 - Friends With A Handful of Benefits.

49e601fa696d.en: They raise their glasses; Harry follows, unsure. "Is she like me?" "{WIP-wozenLady}? Nah. She always wears that nari gel, and she can't use the Wozen interface, though she really wants to." "Really?" Harry lights his hand on fire at will. "I wish I could use the Darfaries interface."
49e601fa696d.t: Mereka mengangkat gelas; Harry ikut, tidak pasti. “Dia macam aku ke?” “{WIP-wozenLady}? Tak. Dia selalu pakai nari gel tu, dan dia tak boleh guna antara muka Wozen, walaupun dia betul-betul nak.” “Betul?” Harry menyalakan tangannya sesuka hati. “Aku harap aku boleh guna antara muka Darfaries.”

4a254e7cf1e4.en: Katsumi wakes up, pushes herself away from Ryo and takes off running. "KATSUMI!" She stops, comes back and goes to punch him in the face, but his adventurer guard, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}, stops her, and she falls to the ground. Ryo: "Hey, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}! No need to get aggressive." The adventurer doesn't reply.
4a254e7cf1e4.t: Katsumi tersedar, menolak dirinya menjauhi Ryo dan memecut lari. “KATSUMI!” Dia berhenti, datang balik dan hendak menumbuk mukanya, tetapi pengawal pengembaranya, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}, menghalangnya, dan dia jatuh ke tanah. Ryo: “Hei, {WIP-rioAdventGuard}! Tak perlu agresif.” Pengembara itu tidak menjawab.

4b19a3a02779.en: Harry goes quiet, thinking of the Bagarisas. "Thinking about them won't bring them back." "But can't I bring them back?" Clodoveu shakes his head. "Reviving animals is a crapshoot, like babies and old people. Worse, Marcus cooked the meat, and you can't revive something that's been cooked. He did it on purpose." Harry seethes. "Please don't light up right now. If you want to bash Marcus's face in, just challenge him to a duel. I bet he'll accept, no problem." Harry takes a deep breath.
4b19a3a02779.t: Harry terdiam, memikirkan Bagarisa. “Fikir pasal mereka takkan bawa mereka balik.” “Tapi tak boleh ke aku hidupkan mereka semula?” Clodoveu menggeleng. “Menghidupkan semula haiwan untung-untung nasib, macam bayi dan orang tua. Lebih teruk, Marcus dah masak daging tu, dan kau tak boleh hidupkan semula benda yang dah dimasak. Dia sengaja buat.” Harry membara. “Tolong jangan menyala sekarang. Kalau kau nak hancurkan muka Marcus, cabar saja dia berlawan. Aku jamin dia terima, tak ada masalah.” Harry menarik nafas dalam-dalam.

4b3372ccda05.en: Clodoveu: "See, Wilson? That's why Marcus doesn't have any friends." "For real, what an asshole—" Something clicks in Wilson's head. "Hey! Don't use my real name! I'm not wearing a fake skin!" "It's fine. By the way, Harry, I'm Clodoveu. Sorry about the Bagarisas, but Marcus is still pissed about what you did."
4b3372ccda05.t: Clodoveu: “Nampak, Wilson? Sebab tulah Marcus tak ada kawan.” “Betul, dasar bangsat—” Sesuatu terlintas dalam kepala Wilson. “Hoi! Jangan guna nama sebenar aku! Aku tak pakai kulit palsu!” “Tak apa. By the way, Harry, aku Clodoveu. Maaf pasal Bagarisa tu, tapi Marcus masih bengang pasal apa kau buat.”

4b9548e556d6.en: Clodoveu turns back to Harry. "So what tickles your brain? You know, what type of girl, or boy, makes you want to fuck them up, or get fucked all night?" Images of the girls he's been with pass through Harry's head, but one stands out. "There was this girl called Sora, a Sanbi maid. She was pretty cute." "What type? Wozefaries, human? Personality? Give me descriptions!" Harry describes Sora in a glowing light, then tells him about the trap Itagiba set for him.
4b9548e556d6.t: Clodoveu berpaling semula kepada Harry. “Jadi apa yang geletek otak kau? Kau tahu, jenis perempuan, atau lelaki, yang buat kau nak hentam mereka, atau kena hentam sepanjang malam?” Bayangan gadis-gadis yang pernah bersamanya melintas di kepala Harry, tetapi satu menonjol. “Ada seorang gadis nama Sora, pembantu rumah Sanbi. Dia agak comel.” “Jenis apa? Wozefaries, manusia? Personaliti? Beri aku gambaran!” Harry menggambarkan Sora dalam cahaya yang berseri-seri, kemudian menceritakan perangkap yang Itagiba pasang untuknya.

4be4a76a2311.en: They throw spells and everything else they can, but that only feeds the fire; they have no idea what the fuck they're doing. They watch the Bagarisa body slowly take shape from the goo. Suddenly, a fire roars with a light so bright that even with your eyes closed it feels like staring at the sun.
4be4a76a2311.t: Mereka melempar jampi dan apa saja yang boleh, tetapi itu hanya menyemarakkan api; mereka langsung tak tahu apa celaka yang mereka buat. Mereka melihat badan Bagarisa itu perlahan-lahan terbentuk daripada lendir. Tiba-tiba, api menderu dengan cahaya begitu terang sehingga walaupun mata kau tertutup, ia terasa seperti merenung matahari.

4c37e7e2e23a.en: Chapter 3 - Sanbi’s Second Courtroom Scientist Apprentice
4c37e7e2e23a.t: Bab 3 - Perantis Saintis Istana Kedua Sanbi

4cf815480f5e.en: "Bringing supplies to the old lady guarding the loot house, but she must have died a few weeks ago, after her fost stone lamp got too small." Wilson: "I smelled her clothes, then searched for her, but all I found was some blood and scraps of torn clothes. A Fatupari must've gotten her." "That's why we now have to bring all the goods back to the den. Someone's next quest—" Marcus: "You fat pussies gonna talk all day? Fucking cuntholes! Step it up!" Clodoveu ignores him. "—will be finding a new den."
4cf815480f5e.t: “Hantar bekalan kepada perempuan tua yang jaga rumah rampasan, tapi dia mesti dah mati beberapa minggu lepas, lepas lampu fost stone dia jadi terlalu kecil.” Wilson: “Aku hidu baju dia, kemudian cari dia, tapi aku cuma jumpa sedikit darah dan cebisan baju koyak. Mesti Fatupari dah makan dia.” “Sebab tulah sekarang kita kena bawa semua barang balik ke sarang. Misi seterusnya seseorang—” Marcus: “Korang pantat gemuk penakut nak bercakap sepanjang hari ke? Lubang pantat celaka! Cepat sikit!” Clodoveu tidak mengendahkannya. “—ialah cari sarang baharu.”

4d582501068a.en: Wilson splashes a torrent of Cold Water on Harry. His flames flicker in and out, then the white soul flame covering his body grows stronger. The flame swells, weaves, then explodes in a curtain of fire.
4d582501068a.t: Wilson menyimbah semburan Air Sejuk ke atas Harry. Apinya berkelip-kelip, kemudian api jiwa putih yang menyelubungi badannya menjadi lebih kuat. Api itu membesar, berpintal, kemudian meletup dalam tirai api.

4ee6b448af64.en: Harry shrieks and rushes Clodoveu with his smaller fist. Clodoveu stops it with his hand, bone cracking all around, punches Harry's gut with the other, then steps back, dodging the big hand, now nearly regrown. He shakes out his hand. "Not even a dent."
4ee6b448af64.t: Harry menjerit nyaring dan menerpa Clodoveu dengan penumbuknya yang lebih kecil. Clodoveu menghentikannya dengan tangannya, tulang retak di sana sini, menumbuk perut Harry dengan tangan yang lagi satu, kemudian berundur, mengelak tangan besar yang kini hampir tumbuh semula. Dia mengibas tangannya. “Kemik pun tak.”

4ef1403868e3.en: He shades his eyes at the sun. "Hmmm! I guess I'll get there by early night." A Bagarisa oinks, bobbing its head at a tree. "Oh! You guys want some of that? Sure!" He brings the fruit down with his power; the Bagarisas go to town, and he cracks one open too. He remembers fleeing the wagon and eating the fruit that made him puke his guts out, and laughs. Yeah. That sucked.
4ef1403868e3.t: Dia melindungi matanya daripada matahari. “Hmmm! Rasanya aku sampai awal malam.” Seekor Bagarisa mendengus, mengangguk-angguk kepala ke arah sebatang pokok. “Oh! Korang nak yang tu? Boleh!” Dia menjatuhkan buah itu dengan kuasanya; Bagarisa melahapnya, dan dia membelah satu juga. Dia teringat lari dari gerabak dan makan buah yang membuatnya muntah sepuas-puasnya, dan ketawa. Ya. Teruk betul masa tu.

4f2591c0a234.en: Dinner: Clodoveu, Marcus (eating alone, pissed), Wilson and Harry
4f2591c0a234.t: Makan malam: Clodoveu, Marcus (makan seorang diri, bengang), Wilson dan Harry

4f55de3244cb.en: Kozaku: "Speak." Clodoveu: "Boss, {WIP-oldHagLootHouse} was eaten by wild animals." Kozaku stands; a flame rises from his heart and runs down his arm along his Darfaries line. His firm steps echo through the big, damp room.
4f55de3244cb.t: Kozaku: “Cakap.” Clodoveu: “Bos, {WIP-oldHagLootHouse} dimakan haiwan liar.” Kozaku berdiri; api naik dari jantungnya dan mengalir ke lengannya di sepanjang garisan Darfaries. Langkahnya yang tegas bergema di bilik besar yang lembap itu.

507d2d052d81.en: One of them steps forward. "We want you to retire." "Sure. How do I do that?"
507d2d052d81.t: Seorang daripada mereka melangkah ke depan. “Kami nak tuan bersara.” “Boleh. Macam mana nak buat?”

50957cb33ab5.en: Wilson laughs. "I saw that one coming!" Clodoveu gives him a thumbs-up. "That'll teach him something new." Harry's body gasps, and he slowly gets up, head pounding as it finishes healing. Clodoveu hugs him from the side. "Anything's a weapon if you time it right. Sorry for throwing so hard. Let's call it a day and head back to the den?" Harry nods.
50957cb33ab5.t: Wilson ketawa. “Aku dah nampak yang tu datang!” Clodoveu mengangkat ibu jari kepadanya. “Itu akan ajar dia sesuatu yang baharu.” Badan Harry tercungap, dan dia perlahan-lahan bangun, kepala berdenyut ketika ia habis sembuh. Clodoveu memeluknya dari sisi. “Apa saja boleh jadi senjata kalau masanya tepat. Maaf baling kuat sangat. Cukup untuk hari ni dan balik ke sarang?” Harry mengangguk.

518ccb06c927.en: "Princesses! Please!" Both stare at Aurora so hard she feels she might crumble. "Princess Maiara, how did you ask for Harry?" The princesses glance at each other, as if suddenly realizing something. Eori crosses her arms. "Maiara asked for a husband who could match her in combat, and Gabiro found someone from the outskirts who apparently had great innate power."
518ccb06c927.t: “Tuan-tuan Puteri! Tolonglah!” Kedua-duanya merenung Aurora begitu tajam hingga dia rasa seperti akan runtuh. “Puteri Maiara, macam mana tuan puteri minta Harry?” Kedua puteri itu saling mengerling, seolah-olah tiba-tiba menyedari sesuatu. Eori memeluk tubuh. “Maiara minta suami yang boleh menandinginya dalam pertempuran, dan Gabiro jumpa seseorang dari pinggir kota yang nampaknya ada kuasa semula jadi yang hebat.”

519dc8f095cb.en: From here, Takeo hunts down the clandestine Magina plantation, doing his own thing, until he comes across Harry and gets interested in his peculiar vibes.
519dc8f095cb.t: Dari sini, Takeo memburu ladang Magina haram itu, membuat kerjanya sendiri, sehingga dia terjumpa Harry dan tertarik dengan aura peliknya.

52239424c0bb.en: Hand on his stomach, he finds a fruit that looks too delicious to be true, and eats his fill. He feels amazing, like never before.
52239424c0bb.t: Tangan di perut, dia menjumpai sebiji buah yang nampak terlalu sedap untuk jadi kenyataan, dan makan sepuas-puasnya. Dia rasa luar biasa, tidak pernah serasa begini.

52341a106e6d.en: He manages to hobble onto his belly, but his arms and legs move on their own; he tastes sweet, then sour, then bitter. He hears Clodoveu, he hears Harry's screams; he sees everything, hears everything.
52341a106e6d.t: Dia berjaya terhencot-hencot meniarap, tetapi lengan dan kakinya bergerak sendiri; dia merasa manis, kemudian masam, kemudian pahit. Dia dengar Clodoveu, dia dengar jeritan Harry; dia nampak segalanya, dengar segalanya.

52f01bf7e826.en: The Wozen lady: "Your team will raid Maicon's warehouse in Forkpoint, then take the loot by boat to Old Village. There, you split up: one side takes the loot north to Fiera's hut, the other follows the river to Minala. Then you switch to a wagon, pass through Rebula, and burn the wagon."
52f01bf7e826.t: Wanita Wozen itu: “Pasukan korang akan serbu gudang Maicon di Forkpoint, kemudian bawa rampasan dengan bot ke Old Village. Di sana, korang berpecah: satu pihak bawa rampasan ke utara ke pondok Fiera, yang lain ikut sungai ke Minala. Kemudian korang tukar ke gerabak, lalu Rebula, dan bakar gerabak tu.”

534ad940ef29.en: In the distance, someone comes along in a boat pulled by an Egua. Harry retreats into the forest with the Bagarisas.
534ad940ef29.t: Di kejauhan, seseorang datang dengan bot yang ditarik seekor Egua. Harry berundur ke dalam hutan bersama Bagarisa.

53a38a94d011.en: "What are you talking about? I am your sister! Listen here! I just want us to be free! Emelia, Arukia and all the other Red Winga people are full of shit!" Katsuki hangs her head and goes silent. "There's no going back now. C'mon. Let's go."
53a38a94d011.t: “Apa kau merepek ni? Akulah kakak kau! Dengar sini! Aku cuma nak kita bebas! Emelia, Arukia dan semua orang Red Winga yang lain tu penuh tahi!” Katsuki menunduk dan diam. “Tak boleh patah balik sekarang. Jom. Kita pergi.”

544324989d1f.en: Harry #10 watches the moon, bundled in blankets, Clodoveu beside him in the house
544324989d1f.t: Harry #10 memerhati bulan, berbungkus selimut, Clodoveu di sebelahnya di rumah itu

546e37dbeb11.en: Huneo and Kibe meet with Neferteri, Itagiba and Eiri
546e37dbeb11.t: Huneo dan Kibe bertemu Neferteri, Itagiba dan Eiri

54a65770af7c.en: Huneo shakes his head. "You're missing a few steps. First, the three others need to approve a new apprentice. Second, a public hair paint must happen. Third, you need to train me up to par. Fourth, you resign publicly, and I take over the post at a public event, too. Those last two can be the same event."
54a65770af7c.t: Huneo menggeleng. “Tuan tertinggal beberapa langkah. Pertama, tiga yang lain perlu meluluskan perantis baharu. Kedua, upacara cat rambut awam mesti diadakan. Ketiga, tuan perlu melatih saya sampai setaraf. Keempat, tuan meletak jawatan secara terbuka, dan saya mengambil alih jawatan itu di acara awam juga. Dua yang terakhir boleh jadi acara yang sama.”

54eea6e9b8c4.en: Harry tanks while the Bagarisas flank, and he lands the final blow, then collapses on the ground, breathing hard. "Oh wow. That was hard."
54eea6e9b8c4.t: Harry menahan serangan sementara Bagarisa mengapit, dan dia melepaskan pukulan terakhir, kemudian rebah ke tanah, tercungap-cungap. “Oh wah. Susah betul tadi.”

550ef8a8295f.en: Chapter 4 - Something fishy, and it ain’t the docks
550ef8a8295f.t: Bab 4 - Ada yang berbau ikan, dan bukan dermaga

55398eb8ddb2.en: Eiri: "Adventurers are giving up on the quest, since nobody can find a hint of where Harry disappeared to." "THEN RAISE THE AMOUNT!" Eiri shakes her head. "I tried, but Huneo blocked it. In his eyes, this quest already pays too much."
55398eb8ddb2.t: Eiri: “Pengembara dah putus asa dengan misi tu, sebab tak ada siapa jumpa petunjuk ke mana Harry menghilang.” “KALAU MACAM TU NAIKKAN JUMLAHNYA!” Eiri menggeleng. “Aku dah cuba, tapi Huneo sekat. Di mata dia, misi ni dah bayar terlalu banyak.”

55c6586d7a35.en: He carves the animal up with a rusty knife, slaps a piece of meat skin-down in front of the Bagarisas, and takes a big piece with him.
55c6586d7a35.t: Dia memotong haiwan itu dengan pisau berkarat, menghempas seketul daging dengan kulit ke bawah di depan Bagarisa, dan membawa seketul besar bersamanya.

56e40339dc86.en: The sisters forced to work a Magina field
56e40339dc86.t: Adik-beradik itu dipaksa bekerja di ladang Magina

57987c42abd2.en: She slowly works her way through the field. The sun and the smell of Magina annoy her to no end. Sweat drips off her chin as she looks up at the distant forest. This time it'll work.
57987c42abd2.t: Dia perlahan-lahan bekerja di sepanjang ladang. Matahari dan bau Magina menjengkelkannya tanpa henti. Peluh menitis dari dagunya ketika dia mendongak ke hutan di kejauhan. Kali ni mesti berjaya.

580e794bec15.en: She seems to get away with it, and she learns a whole lot from trying. "Boss doesn't need to know about the fun times we're having."
580e794bec15.t: Dia nampaknya terlepas, dan dia belajar banyak daripada percubaan itu. “Bos tak perlu tahu pasal seronok-seronok kita ni.”

5841a2adf362.en: "But of course! I plan to give you and her things other than a daily dose of my genes." The lewd smile returns. "But if that's all you want, I'll gladly provide." Katsumi: "If you save my sister, I'll show you everything I learned from the Red Winga." "Everything?" She leans in close. "E—ve—ry—thing," she says in a sensual voice.
5841a2adf362.t: “Sudah tentu! Aku bercadang nak beri kau dan dia benda lain selain dos harian gen aku.” Senyuman miang itu kembali. “Tapi kalau itu saja yang kau nak, aku dengan senang hati sediakan.” Katsumi: “Kalau kau selamatkan adik aku, aku tunjuk semua yang aku belajar daripada Red Winga.” “Semua?” Dia membongkok dekat. “Se—mu—a—nya,” katanya dengan suara menggoda.

5868a2e94ebc.en: Eori, on nari gel, in Huneo's office
5868a2e94ebc.t: Eori, di bawah pengaruh nari gel, di pejabat Huneo

597ebf355ee5.en: Katsumi refuses to spill the beans and spits in the man's face; he slaps her back. Katsuki looks away from her sister, and spills them.
597ebf355ee5.t: Katsumi enggan membocorkan rahsia dan meludah muka lelaki itu; dia menampar balik. Katsuki memalingkan muka daripada kakaknya, dan membocorkannya.

5a2c946ca840.en: Rebula: men posted with weapons and fost stones; Takeo rides up on an Egua
5a2c946ca840.t: Rebula: lelaki-lelaki berkawal dengan senjata dan fost stone; Takeo tiba menunggang seekor Egua

5a4c0fc04151.en: Marcus hands out Bagarisa meat on sticks, one held right in front of Harry
5a4c0fc04151.t: Marcus mengedarkan daging Bagarisa bercucuk, satu dihulur tepat di depan Harry

5ba435cdc97e.en: In a flash, the Bagarisas and Wozens are at each other. Harry watches the Bagarisa that healed him agonize over its death, just like he did, and anger and hatred brew inside him.
5ba435cdc97e.t: Sekelip mata, Bagarisa dan Wozen bertempur sesama sendiri. Harry melihat Bagarisa yang menyembuhkannya menderita menghadapi kematiannya, sama seperti dirinya dahulu, dan kemarahan dan kebencian menggelegak dalam dirinya.

5ba6cdba802f.en: She leans in and whispers slowly in his ear: "If you find out how, I'll let you do anything you want." Harry blushes; so does she. "Not like that! I meant, like—going to other teams! Even working by my side!" They both laugh. She raises her hands and pushes her belly forward; Harry knows this one, and does the same. As their bellies and hands touch, she says, "I promise." Harry smiles and nods.
5ba6cdba802f.t: Dia membongkok dan berbisik perlahan di telinganya: “Kalau kau dapat tahu caranya, aku bagi kau buat apa saja yang kau nak.” Harry tersipu; begitu juga dia. “Bukan macam tu! Maksud aku, macam—pergi ke pasukan lain! Malah kerja di sisi aku!” Mereka berdua ketawa. Dia mengangkat tangan dan menolak perutnya ke depan; Harry kenal yang ini, dan buat yang sama. Ketika perut dan tangan mereka bersentuh, dia berkata, “Aku janji.” Harry tersenyum dan mengangguk.

5c48f2276df6.en: The beast jumps back, then claws open his gut. His intestines spill out onto his skin; the throbbing pain fades, and his whole body warms up. With his last strength, Harry puts his hand on the beast and screams, or rather gurgles, as the flame takes over his fingers and flashes up his forearm before going out.
5c48f2276df6.t: Makhluk itu melompat ke belakang, kemudian mencakar perutnya hingga terbuka. Ususnya terburai ke atas kulitnya; sakit yang berdenyut pudar, dan seluruh badannya menjadi hangat. Dengan sisa tenaganya, Harry meletakkan tangan pada makhluk itu dan menjerit, atau lebih tepat berdeguk, ketika api menguasai jarinya dan menyambar naik ke lengan bawahnya sebelum padam.

5cd16eb9e6a3.en: Harry pictures his friends being roasted alive, and fire surges from his hand up to his elbow. Clodoveu almost misses the transformation, but douses it with a bucket of cold water. Harry shakes violently, freezing.
5cd16eb9e6a3.t: Harry membayangkan kawan-kawannya dipanggang hidup-hidup, dan api meluru dari tangannya naik ke sikunya. Clodoveu hampir terlepas perubahan itu, tetapi memadamkannya dengan sebaldi air sejuk. Harry menggigil hebat, kesejukan.

5d32d19f454b.en: Harry #9-A sees a ghostly human figure far off (point-of-view scene)
5d32d19f454b.t: Harry #9-A nampak susuk manusia seperti hantu jauh di sana (babak sudut pandang)

5d6fc4ecc9e3.en: Bellies full, Harry lies on the ground looking at the stars, the fire pushing back the forest's chill.
5d6fc4ecc9e3.t: Perut kenyang, Harry berbaring di tanah memandang bintang, api menolak kedinginan hutan.

5e11edf5318c.en: Clodoveu: "If you're trying to fuck him, I'm sorry to tell you you're not his type. He prefers Tolerideme women." She blushes. "Aww, whatever. You've got your plan. Now get out!" She leaves. Marcus, dead serious: "Is that what she fucking wanted?" "Oh! Trust me. Totally." Clodoveu rolls up the plan. "All right, homies. You know the plan. Let's get some sleep and leave in the morning." Marcus: "To some good, motherfucking, bloody money!"
5e11edf5318c.t: Clodoveu: “Kalau kau cuba nak main dengan dia, aku minta maaf nak cakap kau bukan taste dia. Dia lebih suka perempuan Tolerideme.” Dia tersipu. “Alah, apa-apa la.
