Korang dah ada rancangan. Sekarang keluar!” Dia beredar. Marcus, serius betul: “Itu ke yang dia nak, celaka?” “Oh! Percayalah. Memang.” Clodoveu menggulung rancangan itu. “Okey, geng. Korang tahu rancangannya. Jom tidur dan bertolak pagi esok.” Marcus: “Untuk duit berdarah yang mantap, celaka!”

5e20a2f31da2.en: The Bagarisas stand up, all facing the same direction, and so does Harry. They squeal in danger. An arrow pierces Harry's flesh. He jumps back into the house and hugs the wall as the arrow burns inside him, a crippling feeling spreading with every heartbeat.
5e20a2f31da2.t: Bagarisa berdiri, semuanya menghadap arah yang sama, begitu juga Harry. Mereka mencicit tanda bahaya. Sebatang anak panah menembusi daging Harry. Dia melompat balik ke dalam rumah dan merapat ke dinding ketika anak panah itu membakar di dalam dirinya, rasa melumpuhkan merebak dengan setiap degupan jantung.

5ec2a244a4a3.en: Marcus comes down. "Your turn, you faggots. It's fucking cold outside." Clodoveu: "That's cute. Let's go stand watch."
5ec2a244a4a3.t: Marcus turun. “Giliran korang, pondan-pondan. Sejuk gila kat luar.” Clodoveu: “Comelnya. Jom jaga.”

5ed877875744.en: They're swapping stories about their adventures and exploits when a tipsy female adventurer plops down next to Hiromi. "Hey! You two! Wanna buy me a beer in exchange for some awesome gossip?"
5ed877875744.t: Mereka sedang bertukar cerita tentang pengembaraan dan aksi mereka apabila seorang pengembara wanita yang separuh mabuk menghenyakkan diri di sebelah Hiromi. “Hoi! Korang berdua! Nak belanja aku bir sebagai tukaran gosip power?”

5ee113e5dbfa.en: Everything is on fire. {WIP-maginafarmBoss} stands. "What the fuck are you?" Someone in the background: "Watch out!" A spell launches at Harry and {WIP-maginafarmBoss}, blinding them both for a moment. "You fucking arsehole!" His sight comes back, and he sees people stabbing Harry, driving him back.
5ee113e5dbfa.t: Segalanya terbakar. {WIP-maginafarmBoss} berdiri. “Apa celaka kau ni?” Seseorang di belakang: “Hati-hati!” Satu jampi dilepaskan ke arah Harry dan {WIP-maginafarmBoss}, membutakan mereka berdua seketika. “Kau bangsat celaka!” Penglihatannya kembali, dan dia nampak orang menikam Harry, menolaknya ke belakang.

5f504e25804b.en: Neferteri says it's super secret research that other kingdoms would try to steal, so it has to stay super secret, even from Father. Nina giggles: "Okay!"
5f504e25804b.t: Neferteri kata ia penyelidikan yang sangat rahsia yang kerajaan lain akan cuba curi, jadi ia mesti kekal sangat rahsia, malah daripada Ayahanda. Nina ketawa kecil: “Okey!”

5f5c4180b753.en: Arukia's face flashes in Eori's mind, and she feels the urge to explode and smash Eiri's face. She turns back to the window. "Get out." "You know, if you need—" "GET OUT—NOW!" A pillow flies; Eiri steps back, hangs her head and leaves.
5f5c4180b753.t: Wajah Arukia terimbas dalam fikiran Eori, dan dia rasa terdesak untuk meletup dan menghancurkan muka Eiri. Dia berpaling semula ke tingkap. “Keluar.” “Kau tahu, kalau kau perlukan—” “KELUAR—SEKARANG!” Sebiji bantal melayang; Eiri berundur, menunduk dan beredar.

5fa8f3f24564.en: An explosion of light in the distance makes the evening as bright as day
5fa8f3f24564.t: Letupan cahaya di kejauhan membuat senja seterang siang

609eef8322f0.en: Marcus leans on the table, ready to pounce. Clodoveu: "You already lost once today. Keep to yourself." "Fuck off. You cunt, get it over with." She slides her hand down her belly into her boxers and flips out a knife that lands right above Harry's head, shaving off part of his mohawk. Harry ducks, covering his face, then peeks as she reaches into her underwear again and pulls out a rolled-up letter. "Keep your dick separate from your mind, or you're gonna die here, kiddo." She throws the letter in front of Marcus, who flicks it to Clodoveu; he sniffs it, shrugs and opens it.
609eef8322f0.t: Marcus bersandar di meja, bersedia menerkam. Clodoveu: “Kau dah kalah sekali hari ni. Diam diri.” “Blah la. Kau pantat, cepat habiskan.” Dia menyeluk tangannya menuruni perut ke dalam seluar boxernya dan mengeluarkan sebilah pisau yang mendarat tepat di atas kepala Harry, mencukur sebahagian mohawknya. Harry tunduk, menutup muka, kemudian mengintai ketika dia menyeluk seluar dalamnya lagi dan mengeluarkan sepucuk surat bergulung. “Asingkan batang kau daripada otak kau, atau kau mati di sini, budak.” Dia mencampak surat itu di depan Marcus, yang menjentiknya kepada Clodoveu; dia menghidunya, mengangkat bahu dan membukanya.

61311b1257e3.en: Through the metal-framed window, Katsuki sees her sister run, then suddenly fall, while the Black Magina field boss has his way with her. She closes her eyes against his boozy breath and tries to ignore it, imagining what life would have been like if the Red Winga had never captured them. Blank. She tries harder, but nothing comes, until she feels him finish inside her. She feels it all, but chooses not to. Memories of her life drift in and out, and it has been nothing but pleasing others.
61311b1257e3.t: Melalui tingkap berbingkai logam, Katsuki melihat kakaknya berlari, kemudian tiba-tiba jatuh, sementara bos ladang Black Magina melampiaskan nafsunya kepadanya. Dia memejamkan mata menahan nafasnya yang berbau arak dan cuba mengabaikannya, membayangkan bagaimana hidup jika Red Winga tidak pernah menangkap mereka. Kosong. Dia cuba lebih kuat, tetapi tiada apa yang datang, sehingga dia rasa lelaki itu terpancut di dalamnya. Dia merasai semuanya, tetapi memilih untuk tidak. Ingatan hidupnya datang dan pergi, dan ia tiada lain hanyalah memuaskan orang lain.

613cd16213cc.en: Yacamim: "How about my foot up your ass? Huh?" Hiromi hugs the adventurer and clinks beers. "Shhhhh, lady! Let her peddle her stuff. All right, what kind of gossip are we talking about?" Like a certain missing person a certain someone is offering ten Sapphires for.
613cd16213cc.t: Yacamim: “Macam mana kalau kaki aku masuk lubang bontot kau? Hah?” Hiromi memeluk pengembara itu dan melagakan bir. “Shhhhh, cik! Biar dia jual barang dia. Okey, gosip jenis apa ni?” Macam seorang yang hilang yang seseorang tawarkan sepuluh Sapphire untuknya.

62629806048e.en: Kibe finds one of Gabiro's journals in a pile; Huneo works at his desk
62629806048e.t: Kibe menjumpai salah satu jurnal Gabiro dalam timbunan; Huneo bekerja di mejanya

627989dd34e2.en: She clears her throat. "The law was followed to the letter, albeit hastily. My vote has no bearing on the matter. Shall we continue?"
627989dd34e2.t: Dia berdehem. “Undang-undang telah dipatuhi sepenuhnya, walaupun tergesa-gesa. Undi beta tidak memberi kesan kepada perkara ini. Boleh kita teruskan?”

6309aef36ee5.en: Itanema: "So that contract wasn't for Maiara, but for Eori?" "Wasn't she always off on those excursions—oh, SHE WAS NOT! She was fucking Harry on the down low! Wow! It all makes sense now!" "See? I told ya. Remember how frisky Arukia was with Harry?" Aurora laughs. "The poor guy had just been revived, and she was already all up in his business."
6309aef36ee5.t: Itanema: “Jadi kontrak tu bukan untuk Maiara, tapi untuk Eori?” “Bukan ke dia selalu pergi ekspedisi tu—oh, TAK MUNGKIN! Dia main dengan Harry senyap-senyap! Wah! Semuanya masuk akal sekarang!” “Nampak? Aku dah cakap. Ingat tak betapa gatalnya Arukia dengan Harry?” Aurora ketawa. “Kesian lelaki tu baru dihidupkan semula, dan dia dah menyibuk dalam urusan dia.”

630a219bab07.en: Hiromi twirls a finger at the bartender, who gives a thumbs-up. "Lemme guess: the Blue Wozens kidnapped a rich merchant's kid again?" "Not even close, you giant feller! The Sanbi Royals posted a quest a few days ago, calling every adventurer to find a guy called Harry. I think Eori's in heat over him or something, too."
630a219bab07.t: Hiromi memusingkan jari kepada pelayan bar, yang mengangkat ibu jari. “Biar aku teka: Blue Wozens culik anak saudagar kaya lagi?” “Jauh panggang dari api, kau budak gergasi! Sanbi Royals letak misi beberapa hari lepas, panggil setiap pengembara untuk cari seorang lelaki nama Harry. Aku rasa Eori pun tengah gersang sebab dia ke apa.”

647fcbab4436.en: He lies down, a hand on his sword; she glances at it without making it obvious. She climbs on top and rides him slowly, moaning, until he's focused only on her. She leans in for a deep kiss, then moves to his ear, moaning, and bites into his neck. Her teeth sink deep; blood gushes into her mouth and onto the ground. He tries to kick her off, but she bites down harder, with all her strength, pinning his hands to the ground.
647fcbab4436.t: Dia berbaring, sebelah tangan di pedangnya; Katsumi mengerlingnya tanpa menunjukkannya. Dia memanjat ke atas dan menunggangnya perlahan-lahan, mengerang, sehingga lelaki itu hanya tertumpu kepadanya. Dia membongkok untuk ciuman dalam, kemudian beralih ke telinganya, mengerang, dan menggigit lehernya. Giginya terbenam dalam; darah memancut ke dalam mulutnya dan ke tanah. Lelaki itu cuba menyepaknya, tetapi dia menggigit lebih kuat, dengan sepenuh tenaga, menekan tangan lelaki itu ke tanah.

654237a9478f.en: Wilson jumps up and runs out. "I told you to go easy on the fat." Clodoveu turns to Harry. "Know where the bathroom is?" "Down the hallway, last door before the exit." "Not bad. Just remember it's not the only exit, and close things behind you on your way out."
654237a9478f.t: Wilson melompat bangun dan berlari keluar. “Aku dah cakap jangan banyak sangat lemak.” Clodoveu berpaling kepada Harry. “Tahu mana bilik air?” “Hujung lorong, pintu terakhir sebelum jalan keluar.” “Boleh tahan. Cuma ingat itu bukan satu-satunya jalan keluar, dan tutup barang di belakang kau bila keluar.”

65e4696df041.en: He steps out early in the morning, the Bagarisas around him, and laziness sets in: as crude as it is, this place is growing on him like a home. "Let's explore up north today."
65e4696df041.t: Dia melangkah keluar awal pagi, Bagarisa di sekelilingnya, dan rasa malas datang: walaupun kasar, tempat ini semakin terasa seperti rumah baginya. “Jom kita teroka ke utara hari ni.”

65fe4e53960d.en: "All right then, you're now my apprentice." Kibe glances at the clouds, then back at the young man. "Now you're the courtroom scientist."
65fe4e53960d.t: “Baiklah kalau macam tu, kau sekarang perantis aku.” Kibe mengerling awan, kemudian kembali kepada pemuda itu. “Sekarang kau saintis istana.”

66dfb9064c49.en: Clodoveu grabs his weapon and steps forward. Marcus: "Don't you fucking dare! He's mine!" "He'll eat you. I'm warning you." Clodoveu rubs nari gel on himself; Wilson opens a nari gel and gulps the whole thing in one shot. Clodoveu: "You're gonna poison yourself with that much Quick Think." (Quick Think: the Time Quicken gel.) "I can do it!"
66dfb9064c49.t: Clodoveu mencapai senjatanya dan melangkah ke depan. Marcus: “Jangan kau berani! Dia aku punya!” “Dia akan makan kau. Aku dah bagi amaran.” Clodoveu menyapu nari gel pada dirinya; Wilson membuka satu nari gel dan meneguk semuanya sekali gus. Clodoveu: “Kau akan racun diri sendiri dengan Quick Think sebanyak tu.” (Quick Think: gel Time Quicken.) “Aku boleh!”

66eb58bde289.en: She feels someone watching, turns, and sees a maid frozen on the floor, seeing Eori act like a wild animal. It dawns on her what she just did. Tears explode from her eyes, and her voice cracks as the word "Harry" forms within the unintelligible grumbles.
66eb58bde289.t: Dia rasa ada orang memerhati, berpaling, dan nampak seorang pembantu rumah kaku di lantai, melihat Eori berkelakuan seperti haiwan liar. Barulah dia sedar apa yang baru dilakukannya. Air mata meletus dari matanya, dan suaranya pecah ketika perkataan “Harry” terbentuk dalam gumaman yang tidak dapat difahami.

676770b81bc0.en: A scream echoes through the air, silencing everyone. Birds take flight and the Egua spooks; her dad calms it down. Adventurer: "What was that?" The other: "Who knows. Can we speed up?" Her dad does. "Let's make the delivery in Banhia and stay the night before heading to Rebula."
676770b81bc0.t: Satu jeritan bergema di udara, menyenyapkan semua orang. Burung-burung terbang dan Egua terkejut; ayahnya menenangkannya. Pengembara: “Apa tu?” Seorang lagi: “Entah. Boleh kita laju sikit?” Ayahnya melajukan. “Jom kita buat penghantaran di Banhia dan bermalam sebelum ke Rebula.”

6801c0f90bda.en: Neferteri sits across from Eori, adventurers standing by her, an empty seat at her side. Eori stares at her with some of Yacamim and Maiara's look. "So what now?"
6801c0f90bda.t: Neferteri duduk bertentangan Eori, pengembara berdiri di sisinya, sebuah kerusi kosong di sebelahnya. Eori merenungnya dengan sedikit pandangan Yacamim dan Maiara. “Jadi sekarang apa?”

6830b0bdacaf.en: Everything is on fire: Clodoveu's whole front is burned, his face marked in the shape of the arm he shielded it with; Wilson runs in the distance; Harry #11-B
6830b0bdacaf.t: Segalanya terbakar: seluruh bahagian depan Clodoveu melecur, mukanya berbekas dalam bentuk lengan yang digunakannya untuk melindunginya; Wilson berlari di kejauhan; Harry #11-B

69e14f2e02ee.en: Neferteri: "Otherwise, I agree, on one condition: Eori becomes an apprentice as well." "Tsk. Sanbi law doesn't limit the number of apprentices. Fine, but she'll have to obey my orders." Neferteri raises her badge. "I won't stand between your way and hers. Dear?" Itagiba: "Well, she's grumpy, but if you think that's best for her in the long run, sure thing." He raises his badge too. Eiri: "I think we should ask her first." Huneo raises his badge. "Three against one. It's decided. I'll break the news to her."
69e14f2e02ee.t: Neferteri: “Jika tidak, beta setuju, dengan satu syarat: Eori menjadi perantis juga.” “Cis. Undang-undang Sanbi tidak mengehadkan bilangan perantis. Baiklah, tapi dia perlu mematuhi arahan saya.” Neferteri mengangkat lencananya. “Beta tidak akan berdiri antara caramu dan caranya. Kanda?” Itagiba: “Yalah, dia pemarah, tapi kalau dinda rasa itu terbaik untuk dia dalam jangka panjang, boleh.” Dia mengangkat lencananya juga. Eiri: “Aku rasa kita patut tanya dia dulu.” Huneo mengangkat lencananya. “Tiga lawan satu. Sudah diputuskan. Saya akan sampaikan berita itu kepadanya.”

6a32c22f21e0.en: Maiara throws down hers and stands. "Are you calling me lazy? Say that to my face again, if you fucking dare!" Eori stands too, finally saying what she has wanted to for years: "You're a lazy bitch!" Maiara grabs her by the collar; Eori grabs her by the hair.
6a32c22f21e0.t: Maiara mencampak miliknya dan berdiri. “Kau panggil aku malas? Cakap depan muka aku sekali lagi, kalau kau berani, celaka!” Eori berdiri juga, akhirnya mengatakan apa yang ingin dikatakannya bertahun-tahun: “Kau jalang pemalas!” Maiara mencekak kolarnya; Eori menarik rambutnya.

6acf8ea07282.en: Harry #11's huge severed hand slams Marcus in the face, throat and chest mid–middle finger; the hand regrows; Clodoveu's arms are twice their size, and Wilson is on Quick Think
6acf8ea07282.t: Tangan Harry #11 yang besar dan terputus menghentam muka, tekak dan dada Marcus ketika jari tengahnya masih terangkat; tangan itu tumbuh semula; lengan Clodoveu dua kali ganda saiznya, dan Wilson di bawah pengaruh Quick Think

6ad973b40bc5.en: A Bagarisa's body rises from the pile of goo
6ad973b40bc5.t: Badan seekor Bagarisa bangkit dari timbunan lendir

6bd644f0659e.en: Eori eavesdrops at Eiri's door while she talks with Sora
6bd644f0659e.t: Eori mencuri dengar di pintu Eiri ketika dia bercakap dengan Sora

6d1070731ea9.en: Neferteri is trying to break her own patterns by getting even more involved with Nina. She knows her narcissistic tendencies, and realizes she's repeating the same controlling bullshit her own parents did, but her conviction that she can do things differently speaks louder: that somehow she can steer the ship back from how far it has drifted from the reality she designed.
6d1070731ea9.t: Neferteri cuba memecahkan corak dirinya sendiri dengan melibatkan diri lebih lagi dengan Nina. Dia tahu kecenderungan narsisistiknya, dan sedar dia mengulangi karut mengawal yang sama yang dibuat ibu bapanya sendiri, tetapi keyakinannya bahawa dia boleh melakukannya secara berbeza bersuara lebih kuat: bahawa entah bagaimana dia boleh mengemudi kapal itu kembali dari sejauh mana ia telah hanyut daripada realiti yang dia reka.

6d32875c51a0.en: "Damn, brotha! Haven't seen you since you retired!" "Still living the life? I'm done with adventuring. Found what I wanted." "For fucking real? You actually found the juiciest pussy in the four kingdoms? Damn, brotha. Proud of ya!" They clasp hands and trade more stories, while a sexually deflated Yacamim rolls her eyes, tosses a few Amethysts on the table and leaves.
6d32875c51a0.t: “Celaka, brotha! Tak nampak kau sejak kau bersara!” “Masih hidup macam dulu? Aku dah habis mengembara. Dah jumpa apa yang aku cari.” “Betul-betul ke ni? Kau betul-betul jumpa pantat paling berair dalam empat kerajaan? Celaka, brotha. Bangga dengan kau!” Mereka berjabat tangan dan bertukar lebih banyak cerita, sementara Yacamim yang nafsunya mati menjeling, mencampak beberapa Amethyst ke atas meja dan beredar.

70769be67e00.en: Clodoveu offers him a cloth. "Your balls might be bigger than mine right now, but they're nari gel balls: fake. Only the balls of your soul truly count." Marcus laughs, standing and channeling Soul Energy to pour water on the fire. "Good luck with that." Clodoveu puts a hand on Harry's shoulder. "I'm gonna help you grow your spiritual balls." "Thanks?"
70769be67e00.t: Clodoveu menghulurkan sehelai kain. “Bola kau mungkin lebih besar daripada aku sekarang, tapi itu bola nari gel: palsu. Hanya bola jiwa kau yang betul-betul dikira.” Marcus ketawa, berdiri dan menyalurkan Tenaga Jiwa untuk menuang air ke atas api. “Semoga berjaya.” Clodoveu meletakkan tangan di bahu Harry. “Aku akan tolong kau besarkan bola rohani kau.” “Terima kasih?”

71ace8ef7df1.en: "Can you guys help me out of here?" Oinks. Wait. Where would I even go? More oinks: they point in a direction, and Harry follows.
71ace8ef7df1.t: “Boleh tak korang tolong aku keluar dari sini?” Dengusan. Kejap. Aku nak pergi mana sebenarnya? Lebih banyak dengusan: mereka menunjuk ke satu arah, dan Harry mengikut.

71f56147a4f9.en: Clodoveu helps him up and holds him from the side as he wobbles. "Points for not running, but that defense was pretty stupid: you knocked yourself out with your own hands." Harry realizes that's basically what happened against Maiara. "So that's when the metal plate hit me in the head!" "If you can't match a defense, go on the offense!"
71f56147a4f9.t: Clodoveu membantunya bangun dan memegangnya dari sisi ketika dia terhuyung-hayang. “Markah sebab tak lari, tapi pertahanan tu agak bodoh: kau pengsankan diri sendiri dengan tangan kau sendiri.” Harry sedar itu pada dasarnya apa yang berlaku menentang Maiara. “Jadi masa tulah plat logam tu kena kepala aku!” “Kalau kau tak boleh menandingi pertahanan, serang!”

72011f6d5c5d.en: "So who did he sign a contract with?" In unison: "The Queen." "Can't you ask her to decide, then?" They avoid each other's eyes, and Maiara leaves without a word. Aurora smiles. A princess lovers' quarrel over a slum boy? I need to tell the girls right now!
72011f6d5c5d.t: “Jadi dengan siapa dia tandatangan kontrak?” Serentak: “Permaisuri.” “Tak boleh ke minta baginda putuskan, kalau begitu?” Mereka mengelak pandangan antara satu sama lain, dan Maiara beredar tanpa sepatah kata. Aurora tersenyum. Puteri-puteri bergaduh cinta pasal budak setinggan? Aku kena beritahu geng aku sekarang juga!

72c1405da7ed.en: "Are we in the clear?" Namia: "I don't hear anyone. Go ahead, my queen."
72c1405da7ed.t: “Kita selamat?” Namia: “Aku tak dengar sesiapa. Silakan, permaisuriku.”

7373f3c25c07.en: Katsumi picks Magina and slams it into the bag, one after another. Someone behind her slaps her for not taking care of the product. She shoves the bag at him, catches him by surprise, throws dirt on him, pushes him aside and runs.
7373f3c25c07.t: Katsumi memetik Magina dan menghempasnya ke dalam beg, satu demi satu. Seseorang di belakangnya menamparnya kerana tidak menjaga hasil. Dia menolak beg itu kepadanya, mengejutkannya, membaling tanah kepadanya, menolaknya ke tepi dan berlari.

751c721b6bee.en: Source: Legacy/Behind The Scenes/Light Novel/Arc #2 - Hifuna Beast.md
751c721b6bee.t: Sumber: Legacy/Behind The Scenes/Light Novel/Arc #2 - Hifuna Beast.md

75ea78d07ff1.en: Not written yet: they talk about Eori.
75ea78d07ff1.t: Belum ditulis: mereka berbincang tentang Eori.

76ba646bc6be.en: "I like her. Send her to my quarters." Katsumi spits on Katsuki. "We're done."
76ba646bc6be.t: “Aku suka dia. Hantar dia ke bilik aku.” Katsumi meludah Katsuki. “Kita dah putus.”

787169a96a89.en: "How?" "For starters, stop fearing the darkness." "You mean death?" "Either way. Darkness will come sooner or later. If you let it rule over you now, you might as well kill yourself." Harry agrees, logically, but dying still feels too real. "Know how many times I've met the darkness? I don't either. Marcus might be sassy, but you can trust him to bring you back, if the boss approves."
787169a96a89.t: “Macam mana?” “Mula-mula, berhenti takut pada kegelapan.” “Maksud kau kematian?” “Sama saja. Kegelapan akan datang lambat-laun. Kalau kau biar ia menguasai kau sekarang, baik kau bunuh diri saja.” Harry setuju, secara logik, tetapi mati masih terasa terlalu nyata. “Tahu berapa kali aku dah jumpa kegelapan? Aku pun tak tahu. Marcus mungkin biadab, tapi kau boleh percaya dia akan hidupkan kau semula, kalau bos setuju.”

78ccf82c7278.en: She imagines all the fun she had with Harry, and craves his smell, his touch and his obedience. She wants to go back to the house, but she can't, now that Neferteri has terminated her contract.
78ccf82c7278.t: Dia membayangkan semua keseronokan yang dia ada dengan Harry, dan mengidamkan baunya, sentuhannya dan kepatuhannya. Dia mahu kembali ke rumah itu, tetapi dia tidak boleh, sekarang setelah Neferteri menamatkan kontraknya.

7b21a1e87f6c.en: Harry #8-C heads back, rod in hand but no fish
7b21a1e87f6c.t: Harry #8-C pulang, joran di tangan tetapi tiada ikan

7bad9a42be55.en: Harry lets the flame take over his hands, arms and head. "I'm coming at full swing this time. Better be ready." The flames swell, as if he's about to explode. Clodoveu crouches, hand skimming the ground, and charges. Harry cocks his arms back, and just as he's about to unleash, a rock flies from Clodoveu's hand and hits him dead between the eyes, breaking his face. His flame flares, then dies, and he falls forward, blood gushing.
7bad9a42be55.t: Harry membiarkan api menguasai tangannya, lengan dan kepalanya. “Kali ni aku datang habis-habisan. Baik kau bersedia.” Api membesar, seolah-olah dia akan meletup. Clodoveu mencangkung, tangan menyapu tanah, dan menerpa. Harry menarik lengannya ke belakang, dan tepat ketika dia hendak melepaskan, seketul batu terbang dari tangan Clodoveu dan mengenainya tepat di antara mata, memecahkan mukanya. Apinya marak, kemudian padam, dan dia jatuh ke depan, darah memancut.

7c3f18820260.en: Autumn colors, the leaves starting to fall. Harry runs, and runs, and runs some more; he doesn't even remember for how long. His legs grow heavy, then his whole body, until he loses his balance, crashes into a tree and falls.
7c3f18820260.t: Warna musim luruh, daun mula gugur. Harry berlari, dan berlari, dan berlari lagi; dia tidak ingat pun berapa lama. Kakinya semakin berat, kemudian seluruh badannya, sehingga dia hilang imbangan, merempuh sebatang pokok dan jatuh.

7f541499ae13.en: Harry, stuck in limbo, sleeping with the Bagarisas
7f541499ae13.t: Harry, tersangkut di alam antara, tidur bersama Bagarisa

8284213b6149.en: Itanema, disappointed, excuses herself. Neferteri: "Furthermore, I foresee Aurora leaking the secret. If that comes true, I want you to talk to Eori and push her to punish Aurora publicly." "As you wish, my queen."
8284213b6149.t: Itanema, kecewa, meminta diri. Neferteri: “Tambahan pula, beta menjangka Aurora akan membocorkan rahsia itu. Jika itu berlaku, beta mahu kau bercakap dengan Eori dan mendesaknya menghukum Aurora di khalayak ramai.” “Seperti yang tuanku kehendaki, permaisuriku.”

82e7154c57b6.en: Harry #8-B fights wildlife alongside the Bagarisas
82e7154c57b6.t: Harry #8-B melawan haiwan liar bersama Bagarisa

82ed6b5ba171.en: Eori, alone in her tower, watches Sanbi bustle below
82ed6b5ba171.t: Eori, seorang diri di menaranya, memerhati Sanbi yang sibuk di bawah

83e1182d27c2.en: Harry spots a village in the distance
83e1182d27c2.t: Harry ternampak sebuah kampung di kejauhan

83e5afffd973.en: Chapter 3 - Payback's a bitch and a half.
83e5afffd973.t: Bab 3 - Balasan memang celaka setengah mati.

8423662649e2.en: Ryo pulls up right beside the broken wagon. "This isn't normal! Look! There's blood everywhere, and even the Egua is gone." He whips the Egua into full speed. "We can't stop until we get there! You two, we're already in danger! Keep your eyes on the sides and behind the wagon!"
8423662649e2.t: Ryo berhenti betul-betul di sebelah gerabak rosak itu. “Ini tak normal! Tengok! Ada darah di merata-rata, malah Egua pun dah tak ada.” Dia memecut Egua hingga laju penuh. “Kita tak boleh berhenti sampai kita tiba! Korang berdua, kita dah dalam bahaya! Perhatikan sisi dan belakang gerabak!”

84dfe5c02e89.en: Spoiler warning: these are unreleased story notes.
84dfe5c02e89.t: Amaran bocoran: ini nota cerita yang belum diterbitkan.

85bc602772d9.en: He gives Harry a manly, comforting hug: warm, though his armpit pulverizes Harry's nose. "Forget the past. Come with us—not that you have a choice—we could certainly use your firepower." Harry feels needed, something he hasn't felt in a long while.
85bc602772d9.t: Dia memberi Harry pelukan jantan yang menenangkan: hangat, walaupun ketiaknya meremukkan hidung Harry. “Lupakan masa lalu. Ikut kami—bukannya kau ada pilihan—kami memang perlukan kuasa api kau.” Harry rasa diperlukan, sesuatu yang lama tidak dirasainya.

86baf7e2be5e.t: Eiri mendengar cerita para pembantu rumah

86c3535faf26.en: Takeo holds up his hand with a carefree look. "You guys offered me a place to stay the night—I can't be that much of a backward ass." He holds his badge up high. "Let's play puzzle! You guys have Black Honey, right?" "Not much, but the other villages can pitch in." "Well—we can look around. This clandestine Magina plantation must be hiding a few treasures too. They're bandits, after all."
86c3535faf26.t: Takeo mengangkat tangan dengan wajah selamba. “Korang dah tawarkan aku tempat bermalam—aku tak boleh jadi bangsat sangat.” Dia mengangkat lencananya tinggi. “Jom main teka-teki! Korang ada Black Honey, kan?” “Tak banyak, tapi kampung lain boleh menyumbang.” “Yalah—kita boleh tengok-tengok sekeliling. Ladang Magina haram ni mesti sembunyikan beberapa harta juga. Mereka penyamun, lagipun.”

8712079cd619.en: The forest at the field's edge invites her to freedom, until an arrow pierces her knee and brings her down. Screaming in agony, her knee torn up and bleeding, she crawls toward the edge until her body gives out.
8712079cd619.t: Hutan di pinggir ladang menjemputnya kepada kebebasan, sehingga sebatang anak panah menembusi lututnya dan menjatuhkannya. Menjerit kesakitan, lututnya hancur dan berdarah, dia merangkak ke arah pinggir hingga badannya menyerah.

873d89e3bb31.en: They talk about {WIP-maginafarmBoss}. Ryo has dealt with him before: he gets pretty crabby at times, but he's still a reasonable guy. Ryo: "So your sister looks just like you?"
873d89e3bb31.t: Mereka bercakap tentang {WIP-maginafarmBoss}. Ryo pernah berurusan dengannya: dia agak panas baran kadang-kadang, tetapi masih seorang yang munasabah. Ryo: “Jadi adik kau nampak sama macam kau?”

87668ed17632.en: Teeth chattering, Harry nearly bites his tongue. "What did I do? I was having dinner with the Bagarisas and someone attacked me! I—" Everything after that is darkness. "So you don't remember, huh? You burned Marcus's tongue inside his own mouth. That was after you nearly sent Wilson to the darkness." Wilson laughs. "For real, I nearly shat myself." "No, you actually did shit yourself." "Oops."
87668ed17632.t: Gigi berlaga, Harry hampir tergigit lidahnya. “Apa aku buat? Aku tengah makan malam dengan Bagarisa dan ada orang serang aku! Aku—” Segalanya selepas itu gelap. “Jadi kau tak ingat, hah? Kau bakar lidah Marcus dalam mulut dia sendiri. Tu lepas kau hampir hantar Wilson ke kegelapan.” Wilson ketawa. “Betul, aku hampir terberak.” “Tak, kau memang terberak pun.” “Alamak.”

877f9acdadb9.en: Eiri proposes raising the quest reward; Huneo refuses, and drills them with questions about Harry, including why nobody can pinpoint his family.
877f9acdadb9.t: Eiri mencadangkan menaikkan ganjaran misi; Huneo menolak, dan menyoal mereka bertubi-tubi tentang Harry, termasuk kenapa tiada siapa dapat menentukan keluarganya.

87801583e4b4.en: Katsuki throws weak punches; Katsumi takes them like nothing. "Don't you realize we had to leave him behind? He became luggage the moment he hit the ground hard!"
87801583e4b4.t: Katsuki melepaskan tumbukan lemah; Katsumi menerimanya seperti tiada apa-apa. “Kau tak sedar ke kita terpaksa tinggalkan dia? Dia jadi beban sebaik saja dia jatuh terhempas!”

87ea91b57f4c.en: Eori cries tears of pure anger, pounding the bed with all her might. Over and over, she sees her tormentor's face, and imagines how tender and sweet it would be to take its life.
87ea91b57f4c.t: Eori menangis air mata kemarahan tulen, menumbuk katil sekuat hati. Berulang-ulang, dia nampak wajah penyeksanya, dan membayangkan betapa lembut dan manisnya untuk meragut nyawanya.

883845e58049.en: Huneo wants a bigger allowance to hunt down all of Gabiro's secret research: it's kingdom property, the people's money! Eiri: Gabiro went on field research and ran research partnerships. Huneo: "I have enough evidence to say, with confidence, that he was using the kingdom's money on private research."
883845e58049.t: Huneo mahukan peruntukan lebih besar untuk memburu semua penyelidikan rahsia Gabiro: ia harta kerajaan, wang rakyat! Eiri: Gabiro pergi penyelidikan lapangan dan menjalankan perkongsian penyelidikan. Huneo: “Saya ada cukup bukti untuk mengatakan, dengan yakin, bahawa dia menggunakan wang kerajaan untuk penyelidikan peribadi.”

88460b4ff102.en: Eiri bursts out laughing, looking up at the castle towers. "Did Eori just say she loves Harry?" Sora: "That was her, without a doubt." "Hmmm. Good that she broke out of her shell, I guess, but where did that come from?" "Love at first sight?" Eiri suspects something fishy. "I guess that's a thing. Maybe all those girly novels rotted her brain." Sora's puffed cheeks give her away. "Okay! I know you like them too, but you're not screaming someone's name out the window!—yet!"
88460b4ff102.t: Eiri ketawa terbahak-bahak, mendongak ke menara istana. “Eori baru cakap dia cintakan Harry ke?” Sora: “Itu dia, tak syak lagi.” “Hmmm. Baguslah dia keluar dari cengkerang dia, kot, tapi dari mana datangnya tu?” “Cinta pandang pertama?” Eiri mengesyaki ada yang tak kena. “Rasanya benda tu wujud. Mungkin semua novel perempuan tu dah busukkan otak dia.” Pipi Sora yang mengembung membongkarnya. “Okey! Aku tahu kau pun suka novel tu, tapi kau tak menjerit nama orang keluar tingkap!—belum lagi!”

88d5196a7d91.en: Face and eye twitching uncontrollably, Kozaku throws Marcus's body aside; blood flies everywhere as it hits the floor, kicking, and splashes the wall. Harry watches, mouth open, as Marcus's body slumps to the floor. Kozaku's twitching stops as he rips the blade out in one swoop, brain matter flying up and raining down on everyone.
88d5196a7d91.t: Muka dan mata berkedut tanpa kawalan, Kozaku mencampak badan Marcus ke tepi; darah terpercik ke mana-mana ketika ia menghentam lantai, menendang-nendang, dan memercik ke dinding. Harry memerhati, mulut ternganga, ketika badan Marcus terkulai ke lantai. Kedutan Kozaku berhenti ketika dia mencabut mata pisau itu sekali rentap, serpihan otak terbang ke atas dan menghujani semua orang.

8984cad25b3f.en: "Forget Marcus. He's always this sassy. Harry, what'll it be? Rest in the darkness, or come have an adventure with us?" Harry smiles nervously. "I guess I have no choice?" "No, no, no. You have a choice. No pressure at all. We could even kidnap Eori and have you torture her instead." Harry feels a weird feeling. "Or, if you don't want to go that far, we can just make sure she never finds you again." Harry agrees. "Then let us begin!" Wilson jumps up: "I call dibs on his hairstyle!" Clodoveu smacks his lips: "And I call dibs on his body gel."
8984cad25b3f.t: “Lupakan Marcus. Dia memang selalu biadab macam ni. Harry, macam mana? Berehat dalam kegelapan, atau ikut mengembara dengan kami?” Harry tersenyum gugup. “Rasanya aku tak ada pilihan?” “Tak, tak, tak. Kau ada pilihan. Langsung tak ada tekanan. Kami boleh culik Eori dan biar kau seksa dia pula.” Harry rasa satu perasaan pelik. “Atau, kalau kau tak nak pergi sejauh tu, kami boleh pastikan dia takkan jumpa kau lagi.” Harry bersetuju. “Kalau begitu mari kita mulakan!” Wilson melompat bangun: “Aku cop gaya rambut dia!” Clodoveu mengecap bibir: “Dan aku cop gel badan dia.”

89b9f55c7871.en: Harry remembers dying at Maiara's hands: the feeling, the hopelessness. The hammer strikes the ground, and Harry jumps.
89b9f55c7871.t: Harry teringat mati di tangan Maiara: rasanya, keputusasaannya. Tukul itu menghentam tanah, dan Harry terlompat.

89bda3c6b391.en: (Art note: maybe a broken mirror on the side, hinting to the reader at the flame on Harry's head.)
89bda3c6b391.t: (Nota seni: mungkin cermin pecah di tepi, membayangkan kepada pembaca api di kepala Harry.)

89f026cd396f.en: Takeo: "You guys playing fort, or what?" Severino: "You didn't hear?" Takeo's eyebrows bounce around as his day replays in his head. "Something about bandits?" "No! There was this loud screech, once, in the afternoon! We think it came from the north."
89f026cd396f.t: Takeo: “Korang main kubu-kubu ke, atau apa?” Severino: “Kau tak dengar?” Kening Takeo terangkat-angkat ketika harinya berulang dalam kepalanya. “Sesuatu pasal penyamun?” “Bukan! Ada jeritan nyaring yang kuat, sekali, waktu petang! Kami rasa ia datang dari utara.”

8b17c41541b4.en: Adventurer: "Impossible! No wild animal would do that, except—" Ryo: "A bandit group trying to pass as wild animals. I can work out a deal with {WIP-maginafarmBoss} to keep us safe." The explosion happens. Adventurer: "That's ominous." Ryo: "It's fine. Whatever was happening must have ended with a bang. {WIP-maginafarmBoss} must have taken care of it. Let's go see!"
8b17c41541b4.t: Pengembara: “Mustahil! Tak ada haiwan liar akan buat macam tu, kecuali—” Ryo: “Kumpulan penyamun cuba menyamar sebagai haiwan liar. Aku boleh buat perjanjian dengan {WIP-maginafarmBoss} untuk pastikan kita selamat.” Letupan itu berlaku. Pengembara: “Petanda buruk tu.” Ryo: “Tak apa. Apa pun yang berlaku mesti dah berakhir dengan dentuman. Mesti {WIP-maginafarmBoss} dah uruskan. Jom pergi tengok!”

8c2bb41a5eb9.en: "So that's why you trust him. Who's the boss?" Clodoveu smiles. "I could tell you all about him, but you won't believe it until you meet him." "Okay—so how should I defend myself?" Wilson laughs. "Even I know that's a stupid question! Oh, wait—" Clodoveu: "I knew you'd come around. Harry, you've got a Bagarisa's power. Nobody else has it! Use it! Abuse it!"
8c2bb41a5eb9.t: “Jadi sebab tulah kau percayakan dia. Siapa bos?” Clodoveu tersenyum. “Aku boleh cerita semua pasal dia, tapi kau takkan percaya sampai kau jumpa dia.” “Okey—jadi macam mana aku patut pertahankan diri?” Wilson ketawa. “Aku pun tahu tu soalan bodoh! Oh, kejap—” Clodoveu: “Aku tahu kau akan faham. Harry, kau ada kuasa Bagarisa. Tak ada orang lain ada! Guna! Salah guna!”

8c5aa6b7fd81.en: Harry #10 and the others haul a load through the forest
8c5aa6b7fd81.t: Harry #10 dan yang lain mengangkut muatan melalui hutan

8d54b5f2f0cc.en: Harry looks at Clodoveu. "Go all out." Harry tries with all his might, and manages only a weak flicker of fire. The boss grabs one of his hands, snaps the bone and rips it off at the forearm. Harry screams as the fire flickers in and out, bursting up his arm and into his head, filling his mohawk.
8d54b5f2f0cc.t: Harry memandang Clodoveu. “Habis-habisan.” Harry mencuba sekuat hati, dan hanya mampu menghasilkan kelipan api yang lemah. Bos itu mencekak sebelah tangannya, mematahkan tulangnya dan merentapnya putus di lengan bawah. Harry menjerit ketika api berkelip-kelip, meledak naik lengannya dan ke kepalanya, memenuhi mohawknya.

8d73f2a9d52e.en: Marcus: "What about the raid? How the fuck are we supposed to do that?" "The scouts noticed there's always a handful of Magina, or Bagarisa Brothers, guarding the place. Go quiet, and we won't have any trouble." Clodoveu looks at Harry. "Makes sense. Harry, you'll turn Bagarisa and throw a fit to grab their attention. Marcus and Wilson will attack them, then fake a run with empty boxes to Rebula, while Harry and I go north." Wilson, half dead: "Whatever, man. I just wanna die."
8d73f2a9d52e.t: Marcus: “Macam mana dengan serbuan? Macam mana celaka kami nak buat?” “Pengintip perasan sentiasa ada segelintir Magina, atau Bagarisa Brothers, mengawal tempat tu. Buat senyap-senyap, dan kita takkan ada masalah.” Clodoveu memandang Harry. “Masuk akal. Harry, kau akan jadi Bagarisa dan mengamuk untuk tarik perhatian mereka. Marcus dan Wilson akan serang mereka, kemudian pura-pura lari dengan kotak kosong ke Rebula, sementara Harry dan aku ke utara.” Wilson, separuh mati: “Apa-apa la, bro. Aku cuma nak mati.”

8f0326989ba4.en: Katsumi holds her hands. "All right, cut it out! Harry is not a savior. He's a nobody like us, and what do nobodies do? They save themselves!"
8f0326989ba4.t: Katsumi memegang tangannya. “Sudah, hentikan! Harry bukan penyelamat. Dia orang biasa macam kita, dan apa orang biasa buat? Mereka selamatkan diri sendiri!”

8fbc296ecae8.en: Ryo holds out his hand to the short-haired sister. "I'm willing to help a stranger, if you pay me back in full." "I don't have balls." "Who said I need money?" "So what? You gonna fuck me in the ass while calling me a whore, like the others?"
8fbc296ecae8.t: Ryo menghulurkan tangan kepada si kakak berambut pendek. “Aku sanggup tolong orang asing, kalau kau bayar balik sepenuhnya.” “Aku tak ada bola.” “Siapa kata aku perlukan duit?” “Habis tu? Kau nak main bontot aku sambil panggil aku pelacur, macam yang lain?”

909de5a7cebf.en: His body freezes, then falls apart like a sliced ham. Harry screams, then devours the body like a seasoned glutton at an all-you-can-eat buffet.
909de5a7cebf.t: Badannya kaku, kemudian hancur seperti ham yang dihiris. Harry menjerit, kemudian melahap badan itu seperti pelahap berpengalaman di bufet makan sepuas hati.

90a5c2bfed4e.en: "Remember what I told you all yesterday." In near unison: "Yes." Eiri pulls Sora in front of her. "No more secrets, okay?" "Yes." "See you all for brunch."
90a5c2bfed4e.t: “Ingat apa aku beritahu korang semalam.” Hampir serentak: “Ya.” Eiri menarik Sora ke depannya. “Tak ada rahsia lagi, okey?” “Ya.” “Jumpa semua masa makan tengah hari awal.”

919967317137.en: "Hold him back!" He readies a Body Destroy spell. "GET OUT!" He launches it at Harry; it splashes on his belly, sending waves of liquefying flesh, bone and skin to the floor, surrounded by soul flame.
919967317137.t: “Tahan dia!” Dia menyiapkan jampi Body Destroy. “KELUAR!” Dia melepaskannya kepada Harry; ia terpercik di perutnya, menghantar gelombang daging, tulang dan kulit yang mencair ke lantai, dikelilingi api jiwa.

91bd37922549.en: His arm slumps to the ground, and so does his head. Harry Sanbi dies in the middle of butt-fuck nowhere.
91bd37922549.t: Lengannya terkulai ke tanah, begitu juga kepalanya. Harry Sanbi mati di tengah-tengah ceruk hutan entah ke mana celaka.

929f332468fa.en: Katsumi and Ryo, in the afternoon
929f332468fa.t: Katsumi dan Ryo, pada waktu petang

93c300fbafd4.en: Harry #10 and the bandits at breakfast

93cd596ed9f9.en: From far off, he hears children playing and people going about their lives. He stands still: he wants to go, and at the same time he doesn't. What if Eori finds me? What if the Red Winga find me? He slips back into the forest.
93cd596ed9f9.t: Dari jauh, dia mendengar kanak-kanak bermain dan orang menjalani hidup. Dia berdiri kaku: dia mahu pergi, dan pada masa yang sama dia tidak mahu. Macam mana kalau Eori jumpa aku? Macam mana kalau Red Winga jumpa aku? Dia menyelinap kembali ke dalam hutan.

93e2586342c2.en: Something moves on his left. "AGRHGHRHHRHGR!" A toothy mouth flashes in front of him and takes him to the ground, and he feels warmth again: his own blood, squirting from his neck. I don't wanna die! I don't wanna die! He flails and hits the beast right in the eyes.
93e2586342c2.t: Sesuatu bergerak di sebelah kirinya. “AGRHGHRHHRHGR!” Mulut penuh gigi berkelip di depannya dan menjatuhkannya ke tanah, dan dia rasa hangat semula: darahnya sendiri, memancut dari lehernya. Aku tak nak mati! Aku tak nak mati! Dia meronta-ronta dan memukul makhluk itu tepat di matanya.

943831949f7f.en: Itagiba, Neferteri, Huneo and Eiri on Harry
943831949f7f.t: Itagiba, Neferteri, Huneo dan Eiri tentang Harry

94eecd2e8dec.en: Severino: "There are a lot of bodies to take care of. We need all the balls we can get. Everyone agreed?" Murmurs ripple through the crowd; nobody feels like being the contrarian, especially surrounded by a sea of dead bodies.
94eecd2e8dec.t: Severino: “Banyak mayat nak diuruskan. Kita perlukan semua bola yang boleh dapat. Semua setuju?” Bisikan bergelombang di kalangan orang ramai; tiada siapa rasa nak jadi penentang, terutamanya dikelilingi lautan mayat.

96cf5c042f93.en: Huneo straightens himself. "I shall report this violation—" Itagiba sighs. "C'mon, Huneo! Cut us some slack here!" "Absolutely not. I bid my king and queen a good day!"
96cf5c042f93.t: Huneo membetulkan dirinya. “Saya akan melaporkan pelanggaran ini—” Itagiba mengeluh. “Alahai, Huneo! Longgarkan sikit untuk kami!” “Sama sekali tidak. Selamat siang, tuanku raja dan permaisuri!”

97410a3e93b8.en: He flies at Harry, throwing punch after punch. Harry blocks a few but can't keep up: bones break, flesh tears, blood spills, and it all heals almost instantly. Clodoveu's timing slows; out of breath, he steps back. "Wooo!" He looks up at Harry's hand coming down with full force.
97410a3e93b8.t: Dia terbang ke arah Harry, melepaskan tumbukan demi tumbukan. Harry menahan beberapa tetapi tidak dapat mengikut: tulang patah, daging koyak, darah tumpah, dan semuanya sembuh hampir serta-merta. Rentak Clodoveu semakin perlahan; kehabisan nafas, dia berundur. “Wooo!” Dia mendongak melihat tangan Harry turun dengan sepenuh kuasa.

97d9c1da624c.en: Huneo: "Arranging the ceremony. I'd like it done in two days." Itagiba: "That soon? There won't be enough time to advertise it." Neferteri stays silent, still suspicious. Huneo points at his massive list of reforms. "There's no time to be jerking around."
97d9c1da624c.t: Huneo: “Mengatur upacara. Saya mahu ia diadakan dalam dua hari.” Itagiba: “Secepat itu? Tak cukup masa untuk mengiklankannya.” Neferteri terus diam, masih curiga. Huneo menunjuk senarai pembaharuannya yang panjang berjela. “Tiada masa untuk main-main.”

98309eae02ca.en: His vision is desaturated, the colors flat, but he sees a wavering, ghostly flame in the oppressive shape of a human, far off in the forest. No thought in his head but the raw, obscenely loud urge to kill. With every step, his hands tickle as a massive fire builds up his arms.
98309eae02ca.t: Penglihatannya pudar warna, warnanya mendatar, tetapi dia nampak api seperti hantu yang beralun dalam bentuk manusia yang menekan, jauh di dalam hutan. Tiada fikiran dalam kepalanya selain desakan mentah yang bingit melampau untuk membunuh. Dengan setiap langkah, tangannya geli ketika api besar terkumpul naik ke lengannya.

9864a43ca00d.en: "Apprentice Kibe." "What?" "My guards were investigating what happened that day, and we came across one more fact everyone glossed over: nobody in the slums knows Harry." "I don't either. I lost all my memories of that day, and of several weeks before it." "I figured as much. Unfortunate. Thank you for your time. Now get on with the tasks I gave you." Kibe walks out.
9864a43ca00d.t: “Perantis Kibe.” “Apa?” “Pengawal saya menyiasat apa yang berlaku hari itu, dan kami terjumpa satu lagi fakta yang semua orang terlepas pandang: tiada siapa di setinggan kenal Harry.” “Aku pun tak kenal. Aku hilang semua ingatan hari tu, dan beberapa minggu sebelumnya.” “Saya dah agak. Malang sekali. Terima kasih atas masa tuan. Sekarang teruskan tugas yang saya beri.” Kibe keluar.

988171231c76.en: Adventurer: "We need to go back right now!" Katsumi: "No! We can't turn around! Do you know what they're doing to her?" "It doesn't matter if we all die! I can't protect you both!"
988171231c76.t: Pengembara: “Kita kena patah balik sekarang!” Katsumi: “Tak! Kita tak boleh patah balik! Kau tahu apa mereka buat pada dia?” “Tak penting kalau kita semua mati! Aku tak boleh lindungi korang berdua!”

99245b29d97b.en: Itanema: "I did just like I told you." Neferteri: "And did Eiri's behavior match my expectations?" "It did. Now where's Sinoi? He hasn't contacted me in weeks!"
99245b29d97b.t: Itanema: “Saya buat tepat seperti yang saya beritahu tuanku.” Neferteri: “Dan adakah kelakuan Eiri sepadan dengan jangkaan beta?” “Ya. Sekarang di mana Sinoi? Dia tak hubungi saya berminggu-minggu!”

9925c8a7522e.en: Kibe flips through it: Gabiro's cryptic scribbles cover everything. "So, did you crack any of his code?" "Of course not. Otherwise we'd have made all his research public, for the good of the kingdom." "I thought so. Good luck with that." He puts the book back and walks off.
9925c8a7522e.t: Kibe menyelak-nyelaknya: contengan samar Gabiro memenuhi segalanya. “Jadi, kau dah pecahkan mana-mana kod dia?” “Sudah tentu tidak. Kalau tidak, kita dah umumkan semua penyelidikannya, untuk kebaikan kerajaan.” “Dah agak dah. Semoga berjaya.” Dia meletakkan buku itu semula dan beredar.

9a62451017d6.en: Hiromi and Yacamim at a small roadside bar between Forway and Sanbi
9a62451017d6.t: Hiromi dan Yacamim di sebuah bar kecil tepi jalan antara Forway dan Sanbi

9b74aee4e3ed.en: Harry, Marcus, Clodoveu and Wilson alone on a wagon: Wilson picks his nose, Marcus keeps watch, Clodoveu and Harry look ahead
9b74aee4e3ed.t: Harry, Marcus, Clodoveu dan Wilson berempat di atas gerabak: Wilson mengorek hidung, Marcus berjaga, Clodoveu dan Harry memandang ke depan

9c08aa66d9ce.en: Marcus: "Shut up." He grabs Harry by the mohawk, yanks his head back and slits his throat. Harry gurgles in agony as the wound heals almost instantly, leaving him panting and weak. Clodoveu: "Was that really necessary?" Marcus raises the knife again. "That was for burning my tongue alive, you motherfucker—who the fuck are you?"
9c08aa66d9ce.t: Marcus: “Diam.” Dia mencekak Harry pada rambut mohawknya, merentap kepalanya ke belakang dan mengelar lehernya. Harry berdeguk dalam derita ketika luka itu sembuh hampir serta-merta, meninggalkannya tercungap dan lemah. Clodoveu: “Perlu ke tu?” Marcus mengangkat pisau lagi. “Itu sebab bakar lidah aku hidup-hidup, kau anak haram—siapa celaka kau ni?”

9c1a6cdee93e.en: Clodoveu: "Harry, want to duel Marcus?" Harry wants to kick Marcus's face in, but the memory of being killed by Maiara sends a shiver down his spine. Marcus smiles. "You fat pussy." He takes a big bite, chews and spits it at Harry; bits of Bagarisa meat and spit run down his face. A flame lights on Harry's fingers.
9c1a6cdee93e.t: Clodoveu: “Harry, nak berlawan dengan Marcus?” Harry mahu menyepak muka Marcus, tetapi ingatan dibunuh Maiara membuat bulu romanya meremang. Marcus tersenyum. “Kau pantat gemuk penakut.” Dia menggigit besar, mengunyah dan meludahkannya kepada Harry; serpihan daging Bagarisa dan ludah mengalir di mukanya. Api menyala di jari Harry.

9d2ba74e4118.en: Author's to-do: have someone in the Wozen party bond with Harry over the things he still remembers, like days having 24 hours. Something to bond over.
9d2ba74e4118.t: Senarai tugas pengarang: biar seseorang dalam kumpulan Wozen rapat dengan Harry melalui perkara yang dia masih ingat, seperti sehari ada 24 jam. Sesuatu untuk merapatkan mereka.

9d717c6e176c.en: The room goes silent, then fills with murmurs about what needs to happen. One confident voice in the back cuts through with a sharp clearing of the throat: "According to Sanbi law, only an apprentice can replace a courtroom scientist." It's Huneo.
9d717c6e176c.t: Bilik itu sunyi, kemudian dipenuhi bisikan tentang apa yang perlu dilakukan. Satu suara yakin di belakang memotong dengan berdehem tajam: “Menurut undang-undang Sanbi, hanya perantis boleh menggantikan saintis istana.” Itu Huneo.

9df679131884.en: He's against the same tree, his shirt in tatters. Everything is back where it belongs, but he's even thinner now, and so are two of the Bagarisas. They healed me! He hugs the two underweight ones. "I'm sorry! I'm sorry! I didn't know!" Understanding oinks, if such a thing can be inferred.
9df679131884.t: Dia bersandar pada pokok yang sama, bajunya compang-camping. Semuanya kembali di tempat asal, tetapi dia lebih kurus sekarang, begitu juga dua ekor Bagarisa. Mereka sembuhkan aku! Dia memeluk dua ekor yang kurus itu. “Maaf! Maaf! Aku tak tahu!” Dengusan memahami, kalau benda macam tu boleh disimpulkan.

9ecdf0dd9539.en: Wilson runs through the forest, mind racing, eyes bloodshot, everything blurred
9ecdf0dd9539.t: Wilson berlari melalui hutan, fikiran berlumba, mata merah menyala, segalanya kabur

9f34e9cf1a95.en: Maiara blushes and glances at Eori. "I'm not lazy!" Aurora: "And everyone knows your accomplishments too, Princess Eori. I can tell you're just burned out from your research. Give it some time, maybe travel a bit to get your mojo back!" She puts her hands on Maiara's broad shoulders. "Maybe cheer on Princess Maiara's tournament?" Maiara keeps glancing at Eori with an attention-seeking smile, and Eori smiles a little.
9f34e9cf1a95.t: Maiara tersipu dan mengerling Eori. “Aku tak malas!” Aurora: “Dan semua orang tahu pencapaian tuan puteri juga, Puteri Eori. Saya boleh nampak tuan puteri cuma keletihan dengan penyelidikan. Beri masa, mungkin mengembara sikit untuk dapatkan semangat balik!” Dia meletakkan tangan di bahu Maiara yang lebar. “Mungkin bersorak untuk kejohanan Puteri Maiara?” Maiara terus mengerling Eori dengan senyuman meminta perhatian, dan Eori tersenyum sedikit.

9fc7d713ad1b.en: Harry lights the fost stone, and the Bagarisas all flee outside, spooked; he tries to play with them, but they won't come back.
9fc7d713ad1b.t: Harry menyalakan fost stone, dan semua Bagarisa lari keluar, terkejut; dia cuba bermain dengan mereka, tetapi mereka tidak mahu kembali.

9fcc73db3d40.en: They still stink, but not so bad anymore; maybe his nose stopped working, but who cares. He feels amazing comfort and protection: the cold wind now feels like an A/C breeze keeping a cozy blanket just right.
9fcc73db3d40.t: Mereka masih busuk, tetapi tidak seteruk tadi; mungkin hidungnya dah tak berfungsi, tapi siapa peduli. Dia rasa selesa dan terlindung luar biasa: angin sejuk kini terasa seperti angin penghawa dingin yang mengekalkan selimut yang nyaman pada tahap yang betul.

a019df1b1b3f.en: Harry #9-B wakes up tied in a basement, to a splash of cold water
a019df1b1b3f.t: Harry #9-B bangun terikat di ruang bawah tanah, disimbah air sejuk

a06c34b34fef.en: On top of her, laughing: "So that's what you can really do? Pathetic! Try harder!" He slaps her across the face. "You should've gone for a left kick instead of flailing your arms around. Now it's time for my payment." He grabs her small hips to turn her over, and she puts her hand on his. He pauses. "I haven't shown you what I can really do yet. Let me do the work." "Finally accepting your fate? All right. What are we doing, then?" "Just lie down. Let me take you somewhere far away."
a06c34b34fef.t: Di atasnya, ketawa: “Jadi itu saja yang kau betul-betul mampu? Menyedihkan! Cuba lebih kuat!” Dia menampar mukanya. “Kau patut sepak kiri dan bukannya kibas-kibas tangan. Sekarang masa untuk bayaran aku.” Dia mencengkam pinggul kecilnya untuk menterbalikkannya, dan Katsumi meletakkan tangan di atas tangannya. Dia berhenti. “Aku belum tunjuk apa aku betul-betul mampu. Biar aku buat kerja.” “Akhirnya terima nasib kau? Okey. Jadi kita nak buat apa?” “Baring saja. Biar aku bawa kau ke tempat yang jauh.”

a09c4cdba0dd.en: "Let's do that, then. Let's go get the approval. Everyone else, just go already." "Not so easy. You need to write a letter summarizing all my qualities, and why I'm the one." Kibe groans. "How do I write this letter?" "I can show you."
a09c4cdba0dd.t: “Jom buat macam tu. Jom pergi dapatkan kelulusan. Yang lain, pergi sajalah.” “Tak semudah itu. Tuan perlu tulis surat yang merumuskan semua kelebihan saya, dan kenapa saya orangnya.” Kibe mengerang. “Macam mana nak tulis surat ni?” “Saya boleh tunjukkan.”

a27d7324d3a6.en: She remembers signing the contract: she was so eager to sign it, and now she remembers her sister was just playing along for her sake. She cries. "I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I'm gonna come get you!" A howl, not so far off, sends a chill through her. She pulls her fost lamp closer.
a27d7324d3a6.t: Dia teringat menandatangani kontrak: dia begitu bersemangat menandatanganinya, dan sekarang dia ingat adiknya cuma ikut sama demi dirinya. Dia menangis. “Maafkan aku. Maafkan aku. Aku akan datang ambil kau!” Satu lolongan, tidak begitu jauh, membuatnya seram sejuk. Dia menarik lampu fostnya lebih dekat.

a386ab5c6fad.en: Katsumi looks for a way out

a3872617ec62.en: Alone, Neferteri closes her eyes. This should further stabilize the situation. Princess Eori. Daughter. Why must you keep acting this way? How should I proceed? How can I speed up the healing?
a3872617ec62.t: Seorang diri, Neferteri memejamkan mata. Ini sepatutnya menstabilkan lagi keadaan. Puteri Eori. Anakanda. Kenapa anakanda terus berkelakuan begini? Bagaimana beta patut meneruskan? Bagaimana beta boleh mempercepatkan penyembuhan?

a6f255f14d3d.en: The adventurer, who seems to be actively trying not to listen: "Watch out!" Ryo stops the wagon. A pack of Bagarisas crosses the road, all seemingly rushing away from something. Ryo: "That's a really big pack." Katsumi: "What are you gonna do with it?" "Make us some balls, of course!" "Us?"
a6f255f14d3d.t: Pengembara itu, yang nampaknya bersungguh-sungguh cuba tidak mendengar: “Hati-hati!” Ryo memberhentikan gerabak. Sekumpulan Bagarisa melintas jalan, semuanya seolah-olah bergegas lari daripada sesuatu. Ryo: “Kumpulan tu besar betul.” Katsumi: “Kau nak buat apa dengannya?” “Buat bola untuk kita, sudah tentu!” “Kita?”

a7943c4dae2f.en: Kibe and Huneo meet with Neferteri, Itagiba and Eiri
a7943c4dae2f.t: Kibe dan Huneo bertemu Neferteri, Itagiba dan Eiri

a7fc6561e1a7.en: Nina reads the contract to Eori, with Neferteri's help
a7fc6561e1a7.t: Nina membacakan kontrak kepada Eori, dengan bantuan Neferteri

a8abfc1c6724.en: Neferteri closes her eyes, thinking. "Might we see this evidence?" "I've handed it to the captains to look into. Suffice it to say, I believe some of those field trips were actually used to hide things somewhere." "If your assumption is true, that would be a grave mistake on his part."
a8abfc1c6724.t: Neferteri memejamkan mata, berfikir. “Bolehkah kami lihat bukti ini?” “Saya dah serahkan kepada para kapten untuk disiasat. Cukuplah dikatakan, saya percaya sebahagian lawatan lapangan itu sebenarnya digunakan untuk menyembunyikan sesuatu di suatu tempat.” “Jika andaianmu benar, itu kesilapan besar di pihaknya.”

a8fc8f94cfd6.en: Harry #11-A stares Marcus down like a wild animal; Marcus is ready to throw down; Clodoveu shields Wilson, who is scared shitless
a8fc8f94cfd6.t: Harry #11-A merenung Marcus seperti haiwan liar; Marcus bersedia bertumbuk; Clodoveu melindungi Wilson, yang ketakutan separuh mati

a92760957229.en: The maids go their ways. Eiri hugs Sora. "Let's go home and take a shower?" A tingle runs through Sora; she turns red. "No wonder you can't find a boyfriend. When Harry's found, you really should wash his back." Sora gets even redder and starts slipping past Eiri, ready to flee. Eiri grabs her. "Ah-ah. You're not running anymore, 'cause you're mine to play with."
a92760957229.t: Para pembantu rumah pergi ke haluan masing-masing. Eiri memeluk Sora. “Jom balik dan mandi?” Satu getaran menjalar dalam diri Sora; mukanya merah. “Patutlah kau tak jumpa teman lelaki. Bila Harry dijumpai, kau memang patut gosok belakang dia.” Sora lebih merah dan mula menyelinap melepasi Eiri, bersedia lari. Eiri menangkapnya. “Ah-ah. Kau dah tak boleh lari, sebab kau mainan aku.”

a9ddd0209021.en: She releases the spell. Another adventurer drives his sword deep into Harry, then sees a lot of Soul Energy flame pouring from the wound. Harry tears through the wagon, sending everyone flying.
a9ddd0209021.t: Dia melepaskan jampi itu. Seorang lagi pengembara menikam pedangnya jauh ke dalam Harry, kemudian nampak banyak api Tenaga Jiwa mencurah dari luka itu. Harry merempuh gerabak, menghantar semua orang terbang.

aa1a0c45da75.en: Kozaku's arm flies into Marcus's gut and rips through him, lifting him off the ground; Marcus pukes his guts out. As his body falls toward Kozaku, a knife appears in his hand and lands right on top of Kozaku's head, piercing his brain.
aa1a0c45da75.t: Lengan Kozaku melayang ke perut Marcus dan merobeknya tembus, mengangkatnya dari tanah; Marcus muntah sepuas-puasnya. Ketika badannya jatuh ke arah Kozaku, sebilah pisau muncul di tangannya dan mendarat tepat di atas kepala Kozaku, menembusi otaknya.

aa3e2baa3b2f.en: "I guess payback's a bitch?" "A bitch and a half. That's for—something in the distance. I can't quite make it out—oh. It's a Fatupari. Never mind, as long as it doesn't come too close." "Fatupari?" "A big-ass snake." "So that's a Fatupari. The Bagarisas and I killed one—and ate it."
aa3e2baa3b2f.t: “Rasanya balasan memang celaka?” “Celaka setengah mati. Itu untuk—ada sesuatu di kejauhan. Aku tak nampak jelas—oh. Fatupari. Tak apa, asalkan ia tak datang terlalu dekat.” “Fatupari?” “Ular besar gila.” “Jadi itulah Fatupari. Aku dan Bagarisa pernah bunuh satu—dan makan.”

aab2d4b588d0.en: Takeo and Severino, with a group of men and some women, see the fission explosion in the distance. Everyone falls silent, struggling to see again. Takeo: "Fuck! My eyes! They hurt!" Severino: "Can anyone see? Shit!"
aab2d4b588d0.t: Takeo dan Severino, bersama sekumpulan lelaki dan beberapa wanita, melihat letupan pembelahan di kejauhan. Semua orang terdiam, bergelut untuk melihat semula. Takeo: “Celaka! Mata aku! Sakit!” Severino: “Ada sesiapa boleh nampak? Taik!”

ab9d25b47e53.en: Everything is fine until his body starts feeling light and his thoughts race so fast he can't follow them himself. His vision blurs; he trips over something and falls to the forest floor.
ab9d25b47e53.t: Semuanya okey sehingga badannya mula terasa ringan dan fikirannya berlumba begitu laju hingga dia sendiri tidak dapat mengikutnya. Penglihatannya kabur; dia tersadung sesuatu dan jatuh ke lantai hutan.

ac0509f7266a.en: The adventurers and Harry keep fighting, going all out. Harry starts to look like he's dying: he suffers, tearing at his own flesh, and he heals more slowly. The fire in his head swells, and he explodes.
ac0509f7266a.t: Para pengembara dan Harry terus bertarung habis-habisan. Harry mula nampak seperti hampir mati: dia menderita, mengoyak dagingnya sendiri, dan dia sembuh lebih perlahan. Api di kepalanya membesar, dan dia meletup.

ac31f2c66d89.en: Ryo, the adventurer and Katsumi come across a broken wagon in the middle of the road, in the evening
ac31f2c66d89.t: Ryo, pengembara itu dan Katsumi terjumpa gerabak rosak di tengah jalan, pada waktu senja

ac979be5fba0.en: "I told ya." Clodoveu grabs his weapon. Wilson sees and hears everything in slow motion. "Cccccccoooooollllddd Wwwwwaaattteeeerrrrr." Clodoveu looks over: Wilson's head is moving, casting a spell three times faster than normal, his muscles so quick they're near the breaking point, his tendons healing with every movement. "Then shock."
ac979be5fba0.t: “Aku dah cakap.” Clodoveu mencapai senjatanya. Wilson melihat dan mendengar segalanya dalam gerak perlahan. “Aaaaaaiiiiirrrr Ssssseeeejjjjuuuukkkk.” Clodoveu menoleh: kepala Wilson bergerak, melempar jampi tiga kali lebih pantas daripada biasa, ototnya begitu cepat hingga hampir putus, uratnya sembuh dengan setiap gerakan. “Kemudian kejutan.”

ad8e8f4b6508.en: Eiri's eyes well up. "Everyone's hiding secrets from me! This isn't fair! FINE! Do what you want! I'm going back to the castle." As she leaves, the pillow flies, and Sora hugs her from behind. "I'm sorry!"
ad8e8f4b6508.t: Mata Eiri bergenang. “Semua orang berahsia dengan aku! Tak adil! OKEY! Buat apa korang nak! Aku balik istana.” Ketika dia beredar, bantal melayang, dan Sora memeluknya dari belakang. “Maafkan aku!”

ae274901ef0d.en: Clodoveu: "The den's a ways off. First we walk half a day to our hidden wagon, take it to the next hideout, then walk about a quarter timehunk." "Are all the teams there?" "We rarely see the other teams. We only go back to the den to report and grab the next quest." "So what was your current quest? Killing me?"
ae274901ef0d.t: Clodoveu: “Sarang tu agak jauh. Mula-mula kita jalan setengah hari ke gerabak tersembunyi kita, bawa ke tempat persembunyian seterusnya, kemudian jalan lebih kurang suku timehunk.” “Semua pasukan ada di sana?” “Kami jarang jumpa pasukan lain. Kami cuma balik ke sarang untuk lapor dan ambil misi seterusnya.” “Jadi apa misi korang sekarang? Bunuh aku?”

ae6603b7662c.en: Maiara wins the final round. Eori throws down her pieces, downs her drink and slams the cup. "How can you live like this? This is too boring!"
ae6603b7662c.t: Maiara memenangi pusingan akhir. Eori mencampak buah permainannya, meneguk minumannya dan menghempas cawan. “Macam mana kau boleh hidup macam ni? Bosan gila!”

aeab819948dc.en: Dalila with her parents and two adventurers, one with a Winga
aeab819948dc.t: Dalila bersama ibu bapanya dan dua orang pengembara, seorang dengan seekor Winga

aeefef50cfac.en: Eori slams the door and points at them. "Harry is your fault! FIX IT!—" Neferteri's eyes widen: Eori seems about to say what she has feared she would say. Huneo steps in between. "THIS IS NOT HOW YOU TREAT THE QUEEN!" Itagiba stands. "Huneo, it's fine. We understand." "Absolutely not! This is unacceptable! Eori! As my second apprentice, I demand you apologize RIGHT NOW!"
aeefef50cfac.t: Eori menghempas pintu dan menuding mereka. “Harry salah korang! BETULKAN!—” Mata Neferteri terbeliak: Eori seolah-olah hendak mengatakan apa yang ditakutinya selama ini. Huneo masuk di tengah-tengah. “BUKAN BEGINI CARA MELAYAN PERMAISURI!” Itagiba berdiri. “Huneo, tak apa. Kami faham.” “Sama sekali tidak! Ini tidak boleh diterima! Eori! Sebagai perantis kedua saya, saya menuntut kau minta maaf SEKARANG JUGA!”

b01813d3ee29.en: Ryo puts on a lewd smile. "I don't like calling people names. I guess I'm the silent type. Plus, you could just start with your hand, and then we move on to the others." He holds his hand out further. Katsumi smiles back slightly and takes it. "I'm Ryo Flatland Long-Blue. Pleasure to be of service." "I'm Katsumi. I need help saving my sister from a Magina field."
b01813d3ee29.t: Ryo mengukir senyuman miang. “Aku tak suka panggil orang dengan nama buruk. Rasanya aku jenis pendiam. Lagipun, kau boleh mula dengan tangan kau dulu, kemudian kita beralih ke yang lain.” Dia menghulurkan tangannya lebih jauh. Katsumi tersenyum sedikit dan menyambutnya. “Aku Ryo Flatland Long-Blue. Gembira dapat berkhidmat.” “Aku Katsumi. Aku perlukan bantuan selamatkan adik aku dari ladang Magina.”

b1657bc6488b.en: He pulls out, slaps her ass and walks out. Katsuki just stands there, waiting for something. Anything.
b1657bc6488b.t: Lelaki itu menarik keluar, menampar punggungnya dan keluar. Katsuki hanya berdiri di situ, menunggu sesuatu. Apa saja.

b2eb8b22a8fc.en: He falls forward, every breath leaving him more breathless, and slumps to the side. Another ghostly figure appears with a two-handed weapon and studies him. He barely lifts a heavy hand: he wants to kill it, but he can't. He whimpers in agony, closer to death with every breath.
b2eb8b22a8fc.t: Dia jatuh ke depan, setiap nafas membuatnya lebih sesak, dan terkulai ke sisi. Satu lagi susuk seperti hantu muncul dengan senjata dua tangan dan mengamatinya. Dia hampir tidak mampu mengangkat tangan yang berat: dia mahu membunuhnya, tetapi tidak boleh. Dia merengek dalam derita, semakin dekat dengan kematian dengan setiap nafas.

b2f49889ca2c.en: His feet touch the ground again; he steps away and turns around. The Wozen lady smiles. "Fost stones only keep dumb animals away. Aren't you cold?" Harry looks at his half-naked self. "Hmm. I guess not?"
b2f49889ca2c.t: Kakinya menyentuh tanah semula; dia menjauh dan berpaling. Wanita Wozen itu tersenyum. “Fost stone cuma halau haiwan bodoh. Kau tak sejuk ke?” Harry memandang dirinya yang separuh bogel. “Hmm. Rasanya tak?”

b38275b7de2d.en: Yacamim sits back down and slams her mug so hard it dings both the mug and the table. "Hey, you two! Gonna pay for that, or do you want someone to teach you a lesson?" A big man, not unlike Hiromi but much older, comes out of the corner. They square up, fists thirsting for blood, and at the last second do the Darfaries greeting.
b38275b7de2d.t: Yacamim duduk semula dan menghempas kolenya begitu kuat hingga kole dan meja itu kemik. “Hoi, korang berdua! Nak bayar ke, atau nak orang ajar korang?” Seorang lelaki besar, tidak jauh beza dengan Hiromi tetapi jauh lebih tua, keluar dari sudut. Mereka bersemuka, penumbuk dahagakan darah, dan pada saat akhir melakukan salam Darfaries.

b861ebf475d0.en: Harry outside at sunrise, a fost lamp beside him; the Wozen lady hides in the tree above
b861ebf475d0.t: Harry di luar ketika matahari terbit, lampu fost di sebelahnya; wanita Wozen bersembunyi di pokok di atasnya

b92819966b65.en: Clodoveu raises his weapon; Harry closes his eyes, ready to die again
b92819966b65.t: Clodoveu mengangkat senjatanya; Harry memejamkan mata, bersedia mati lagi

b94fea99a172.en: At the farm, a Black Magina girl chews on flowers while a guy fucks her
b94fea99a172.t: Di ladang, seorang gadis Black Magina mengunyah bunga sementara seorang lelaki menyetubuhinya

b9e21bab3710.en: {WIP-rubelaGirl}: "To where? This is our home!" The men in the background cheer. "We're gonna kick its teeth in!" Takeo: "Well, if you feed me and give me a place to sleep tonight, I can help too." {WIP-rubelaGirl}: "You sure about that? What if Forway finds out?" Takeo: "Will anyone tell?" He peeks through the crowd; everyone shakes their heads. With a smile: "Then all good."
b9e21bab3710.t: {WIP-rubelaGirl}: “Ke mana? Inilah rumah kami!” Lelaki-lelaki di belakang bersorak. “Kami akan rontokkan gigi dia!” Takeo: “Yalah, kalau korang bagi aku makan dan tempat tidur malam ni, aku boleh tolong juga.” {WIP-rubelaGirl}: “Kau pasti? Macam mana kalau Forway dapat tahu?” Takeo: “Ada orang nak beritahu ke?” Dia mengintai melalui orang ramai; semua orang menggeleng. Dengan senyuman: “Kalau macam tu semua okey.”

ba0185c2fa88.en: Ryo proposes a deal: if the sisters tell him everything they know about the Red Winga, and everyone they got their information from, he'll keep them hidden while he tries to negotiate a contract cancellation.
ba0185c2fa88.t: Ryo mencadangkan satu perjanjian: jika dua beradik itu memberitahunya semua yang mereka tahu tentang Red Winga, dan semua orang yang menjadi sumber maklumat mereka, dia akan menyembunyikan mereka sementara dia cuba merundingkan pembatalan kontrak.

ba0c093ab7cb.en: Marcus: "I'm gonna fucking skin you alive and eat you, you fat piece of shit!" Harry trucks toward him, head tilted forward to strike, ready to squish him like a strawberry in a fist. Marcus waits until the last second, then dances out of the way and slashes Harry's arm open as it passes.
ba0c093ab7cb.t: Marcus: “Aku akan siat kulit kau hidup-hidup dan makan kau, kau taik gemuk!” Harry meluru ke arahnya, kepala condong ke depan untuk menyerang, bersedia memenyetkannya seperti strawberi dalam genggaman. Marcus menunggu hingga saat akhir, kemudian menari mengelak dan menetak lengan Harry hingga terbuka ketika ia lalu.

ba8d2785ef50.en: He injures one, but the other kills him. This happens before the prologue of Book 1 (see the Webcomic).
ba8d2785ef50.t: Dia mencederakan seorang, tetapi yang seorang lagi membunuhnya. Ini berlaku sebelum prolog Buku 1 (lihat Webcomic).

bb54b6dc8183.en: Severino: "We can't leave these people behind!" Takeo points at some slightly burned Maginas. "They're bandits!" "They're innocent people! I told Forway about this farm, about the kidnappings, but you guys never did anything!" "Well, that's because you never set the right price!" "Like we have the money!" "I know. I'm not arguing with you. But you've got to understand our side too. It costs a lot!" "Then what are you gonna do?"
bb54b6dc8183.t: Severino: “Kita tak boleh tinggalkan orang-orang ni!” Takeo menunjuk beberapa Magina yang sedikit terbakar. “Mereka penyamun!” “Mereka orang tak bersalah! Aku dah beritahu Forway pasal ladang ni, pasal penculikan, tapi korang tak pernah buat apa-apa!” “Yalah, sebab korang tak pernah letak harga yang betul!” “Macamlah kami ada duit!” “Aku tahu. Aku bukan nak bertengkar dengan kau. Tapi kau kena faham pihak kami juga. Kosnya banyak!” “Habis kau nak buat apa?”

bbe2e042a0d6.en: "Then get the fuck out!" "It seems you didn't hear the verdict, so I'll repeat it: you're my second apprentice now, which means you'll do my bidding. Report to the castle lab right now to develop new nari gels." "I'M NOT YOUR BITCH! FUCK OFF!" "Guards, arrest her for contempt." Eori fights the guards and loses. Pinned to the floor, she sees Neferteri peeking from the hallway. "Fucking bitch. You'll pay for this."
bbe2e042a0d6.t: “Kalau macam tu berambus, celaka!” “Nampaknya kau tak dengar keputusan itu, jadi saya ulang: kau perantis kedua saya sekarang, yang bermakna kau akan ikut perintah saya. Lapor diri ke makmal istana sekarang juga untuk membangunkan nari gel baharu.” “AKU BUKAN JALANG KAU! BLAH LA!” “Pengawal, tangkap dia kerana menghina.” Eori melawan pengawal dan kalah. Tersepit di lantai, dia nampak Neferteri mengintai dari lorong. “Jalang celaka. Kau akan bayar untuk ni.”

bcb3dc75fda3.en: Wilson: "Something less boring would be nice." Clodoveu: "Big words from someone shitting himself just yesterday." "Nah. I wasn't shitting myself, I was lightening my load to run faster." He laughs. Clodoveu takes him seriously. "That's an interesting strategy. Harry, you could use that to pick up your pace." Harry thinks about it, and shakes his head. "I'll pass."
bcb3dc75fda3.t: Wilson: “Sesuatu yang kurang membosankan pun bagus juga.” Clodoveu: “Cakap besar daripada orang yang terberak semalam.” “Tak. Aku tak terberak, aku ringankan muatan supaya boleh lari lebih laju.” Dia ketawa. Clodoveu menganggapnya serius. “Strategi yang menarik. Harry, kau boleh guna tu untuk percepatkan langkah.” Harry memikirkannya, dan menggeleng. “Tak apalah.”

bcf4232871f7.en: The sisters flee the bandits in the rain
bcf4232871f7.t: Adik-beradik itu lari daripada penyamun dalam hujan

bd8c6ea3bf01.en: Eori and Maiara, drinks in hand, play Minari in the castle parlor
bd8c6ea3bf01.t: Eori dan Maiara, minuman di tangan, bermain Minari di ruang tamu istana

bd8e3b549c5e.en: Harry: "Can I ask why you gave me that nari bulking-up gel?" "So you can carry weight for us!" He finishes the haircut. "Now it's perfect! Say, wanna go wrestle outside before we shower?" Harry looks at Wilson, then at Clodoveu, and feels a choking atmosphere coming from the latter. "Nooo?" "That's too bad. Wilson?" Wilson laughs nervously. "Fuuuuck no. I ain't falling for that again." "What? It was purely an accident that I got hard." "I dunno about that. I'm just gonna go to sleep instead." "All right. Night!"
bd8e3b549c5e.t: Harry: “Boleh aku tanya kenapa korang bagi aku gel nari pembesar badan tu?” “Supaya kau boleh angkat barang untuk kami!” Dia menghabiskan potongan rambut. “Sekarang dah sempurna! Eh, nak bergusti kat luar sebelum kita mandi?” Harry memandang Wilson, kemudian Clodoveu, dan merasakan suasana mencekik datang daripada yang kedua. “Taaak?” “Sayang sekali. Wilson?” Wilson ketawa gugup. “Taaak nak, celaka. Aku takkan tertipu lagi.” “Apa? Memang betul-betul kebetulan aku keras masa tu.” “Entahlah. Aku tidur je la.” “Okey. Selamat malam!”

bdea6b7a8eab.en: A loud, fierce gust of air claps through the village. Some people fall over, some trees break, and branches, bits of houses and even small mammals are swept up by the wind and sent flying.
bdea6b7a8eab.t: Satu tiupan udara yang kuat dan ganas menampar seluruh kampung. Ada yang jatuh, ada pokok yang patah, dan dahan, cebisan rumah malah mamalia kecil diterbangkan angin dan dihantar melayang.

bf176af19602.en: Marcus: "Maicon. Does he show up there?" "A dead merchant doesn't make money. Kill him, and I'll gut you alive." "Tsk. Kill one, two more show up. Who fucking cares?" She slams the table, almost breaking it. "I fucking care." Marcus stands, ready to throw down.
bf176af19602.t: Marcus: “Maicon. Dia datang ke sana?” “Saudagar mati tak buat duit. Bunuh dia, dan aku siang kau hidup-hidup.” “Cis. Bunuh seorang, dua lagi muncul. Siapa celaka peduli?” Dia menghentak meja, hampir mematahkannya. “Aku peduli, celaka.” Marcus berdiri, bersedia bertumbuk.

bf2d01fc1267.en: Their son, Vitor, appears. "Mom! Dad! Look what I found!" After a bit of family time, Severino brings him outside to chop firewood together. Vitor is getting ready to chop when a screech sounds in the distance.
bf2d01fc1267.t: Anak lelaki mereka, Vitor, muncul. “Mak! Ayah! Tengok apa Vitor jumpa!” Selepas sedikit masa bersama keluarga, Severino membawanya keluar untuk membelah kayu api bersama. Vitor sedang bersiap membelah apabila satu jeritan nyaring kedengaran di kejauhan.

c02578ef85a4.en: The cold rain feels like ice cubes trying to pierce his skin. The fire on his fingertips is his only salvation, until a gust of wind breaks his concentration and puts it out. He's shaking too much to light it again; the bitter cold takes over his mind every time. Wozen eyes watch from the background.
c02578ef85a4.t: Hujan sejuk terasa seperti ketulan ais cuba menembusi kulitnya. Api di hujung jarinya satu-satunya penyelamat, sehingga sehembus angin memecahkan tumpuannya dan memadamkannya. Dia menggigil terlalu kuat untuk menyalakannya lagi; sejuk yang pedih menguasai mindanya setiap kali. Mata Wozen memerhati dari belakang.

c05498abea47.en: Lighting the way with fost stones, they see a wild animal feasting on a body. It turns on them: a large Bagarisa. It kills some of them, but they manage to fight it off. When did Bagarisas get so violent? Takeo: "That was the Hifuna beast."
c05498abea47.t: Menerangi jalan dengan fost stone, mereka nampak seekor haiwan liar sedang melahap sebuah mayat. Ia berpaling kepada mereka: seekor Bagarisa besar. Ia membunuh sebahagian daripada mereka, tetapi mereka berjaya menghalaunya. Sejak bila Bagarisa jadi seganas ini? Takeo: “Itulah Hifuna beast tu.”

c086ee600a14.en: He stands silent for a moment, body frozen, eyes paralyzed, until a twitch in his eyes and hands breaks the stillness. He cracks his neck and stands face to face with Harry. Pure terror runs up Harry's spine; he can't react to such overwhelming power. "Show me."
c086ee600a14.t: Dia berdiri diam seketika, badan kaku, mata lumpuh, sehingga kedutan di mata dan tangannya memecahkan kesunyian. Dia meletupkan lehernya dan berdiri bersemuka dengan Harry. Kengerian tulen menjalar naik tulang belakang Harry; dia tidak dapat bertindak balas terhadap kuasa yang begitu dahsyat. “Tunjukkan.”

c16f5220a989.en: Dalila comes face to face with Harry #11 as she releases her spell
c16f5220a989.t: Dalila bersemuka dengan Harry #11 ketika dia melepaskan jampinya

c27354012307.en: "Selling yourself to a scientist? Is that what people do?" "Could be. Care to tell me how you got this Bagarisa power?" Harry hesitates: he sees Eiri telling him not to say anything, pinky out. Anger wins, and he nods.
c27354012307.t: “Jual diri kepada saintis? Orang buat macam tu ke?” “Mungkin. Nak cerita macam mana kau dapat kuasa Bagarisa ni?” Harry teragak-agak: dia nampak Eiri menyuruhnya jangan cakap apa-apa, jari kelingking terjulur. Kemarahan menang, dan dia mengangguk.

c3446fc69804.en: Severino turns serious. He hears the forest fauna going crazy, and sees birds and other animals fleeing something to the north. "Dad?" Severino kneels to his son's level and grabs his shoulder. "Son, I need your help." Vitor puffs out his chest, ready. "Bring the bell to the center of the village and pound on it. Tell people to gather their fost stones and weapons."
c3446fc69804.t: Severino menjadi serius. Dia mendengar fauna hutan menggila, dan nampak burung dan haiwan lain lari daripada sesuatu di utara. “Ayah?” Severino melutut ke paras anaknya dan memegang bahunya. “Nak, ayah perlukan bantuan kau.” Vitor membusungkan dada, bersedia. “Bawa loceng ke tengah kampung dan pukul. Suruh orang kumpul fost stone dan senjata mereka.”

c3885fc4b9b7.en: "You losers got lucky this time." She grabs Harry's hand, and he cowers. A warm, moist feeling: her tongue is wide and her mouth is big; Harry feels he could disappear in it. She pulls his whole hand out of her mouth and spits to the side. "He's more Bagarisa than human. The boss gave your team a shot, so you'd better not fuck it up." Marcus: "Just tell us what to do, and fuck off."
c3885fc4b9b7.t: “Korang yang kalah ni bernasib baik kali ni.” Dia menggenggam tangan Harry, dan Harry kecut. Rasa hangat dan lembap: lidahnya lebar dan mulutnya besar; Harry rasa dia boleh hilang di dalamnya. Dia menarik seluruh tangan Harry keluar dari mulutnya dan meludah ke tepi. “Dia lebih Bagarisa daripada manusia. Bos dah beri pasukan korang peluang, jadi baik korang jangan rosakkan.” Marcus: “Beritahu saja apa nak buat, dan blah.”

c396ee72cee6.en: Everyone steps back. {WIP-maginafarmBoss} stabs his sword into the floor. "Find out who sent—" Harry's soul flame lights up amid the pool of liquefied flesh. They see the pool splitting evenly. "There's something there!"
c396ee72cee6.t: Semua orang berundur. {WIP-maginafarmBoss} menikam pedangnya ke lantai. “Cari siapa yang hantar—” Api jiwa Harry menyala di tengah-tengah takungan daging yang mencair. Mereka nampak takungan itu terbelah sama rata. “Ada sesuatu di situ!”

c43422c9e73d.en: Eori was on her way to talk to Neferteri, but hears Eiri crying instead, and listens closely. Sora: "C'mon, Eiri! You've got to let him go! You've seen what became of the quest—" An urge rises inside Eori. She opens the door. "WHAT BECAME OF IT?"
c43422c9e73d.t: Eori dalam perjalanan untuk bercakap dengan Neferteri, tetapi terdengar Eiri menangis, dan mendengar dengan teliti. Sora: “Sudahlah, Eiri! Kau kena lepaskan dia! Kau dah nampak apa jadi dengan misi tu—” Satu desakan bangkit dalam diri Eori. Dia membuka pintu. “APA JADI DENGANNYA?”

c486223c4c5f.en: Marcus sits across from Harry, eating Bagarisa jerky and provoking him. Harry, gripping his coffee, wants to bash that smirk in like nobody's business; Clodoveu watches; Wilson is oblivious, picking his nose, his mind far away.
